description: Kitutu Masaba Technical and Vocational College was established as a public TVET institution under the Ministry of Education and admitted its first trainees in 2021. Its stated mission is to provide quality professional and technical training anchored on research, innovation, science, engineering, technology and business skills, with a vision of becoming a centre of excellence in science, engineering, technology and business programmes. Teaching is organised on the modular Competency-Based Education and Training model approved by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council, running from Level 3 through Level 6, alongside NITA-accredited trade-test short courses. The college describes itself as a Centre of Excellence in Refrigeration and Air Conditioning and operates departments covering electrical, mechanical and automotive, computing and informatics, building and civil, fashion design, hospitality and tourism, business and entrepreneurship, agriculture and environmental studies, and cosmetology. It reports accreditation with TVETA, NITA and KNEC, though the TVETA register snapshot of 24 October 2026 records its licence as expired on 20 July 2026.

about: Kiharu Technical College Murang'a (KTCM) is a public Technical and Vocational College in Kiharu, Murang'a County, Kenya, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0029/2023 on 9 October 2023, with the registration valid to 8 October 2028. The college delivers competence-based technical training across ten schools, including building and civil engineering, electrical engineering, computing, automotive engineering, hospitality, business, cosmetology, journalism, and medical and applied sciences, with programmes examined by KNEC, TVETA-accredited CDACC and NITA.
description: Kiharu Technical College Murang'a is a public Technical and Vocational College operating from Kiharu in Murang'a County, Kenya. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority registered it under TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0029/2023 on 9 October 2023 with the licence running to 8 October 2028. Its academic offer is organised into ten schools covering building and civil engineering, electrical and electronic engineering, computing and informatics, automotive engineering, medical and applied sciences, business and economics, hospitality and institutional management, cosmetology, fashion and design, and journalism and media studies. The college publishes 84 programme cards on its own courses page, spanning diploma, certificate and artisan awards examined by KNEC, CDACC and NITA, with a separate KASNEB accounting technician diploma; professional CPA study is advertised at foundational level but does not map to a canonical award. Its website carries a student portal, an online application portal, a staff ERP and 'E-Learning' and 'E-Revision' menu items, but both of those items currently point to page anchors rather than a delivered learning platform.

Opened in 2024, it is registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority and trains more than 2,000 learners in competency-based certificate, artisan and diploma programmes across eight academic departments.
description: Mbita Technical and Vocational College (Mbita TVC) is a public technical and vocational institution established in 2024 and registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0026/2024, registered on 29 October 2024 with a licence valid to 28 October 2029. The college sits on the Homabay-Mbita road and describes itself as serving learners drawn from Homa Bay, Migori, Kisumu and Siaya counties and the wider Lake Victoria Basin. Its stated mission is to provide accessible, relevant and high-quality TVET that equips trainees with industry-driven competencies, and its own welcome page reports that it has grown to serve over 2,000 trainees across technical and vocational disciplines. Academic work is organised into eight departments covering mechanical and automotive, electrical and electronics, building and civil engineering, computing and informatics, hospitality and institutional management, business and entrepreneurship, agriculture and environmental studies, and liberal studies. The TVETA register of accredited programmes lists 44 qualifications including KNEC diploma, craft and artisan trades and CDACC competency-based levels, and the college advertises 70 per cent practical training with KUCCPS placement.

description: Dundori Vocational Training Centre is a public vocational training centre in Dundori Ward, Bahati Sub-County, Nakuru County, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0117/2018. about: Goshen Medical & Technical College is a private Technical and Vocational College in Thika, Kiambu County, Kenya, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0086/2020 on 21 October 2020 with a licence valid to 10 November 2030. description: Goshen Medical & Technical College is a private medical and technical college based at Makongeni in Thika, Kiambu County, Kenya. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority registered it on 21 October 2020 under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0086/2020, and the registration remains valid to 10 November 2030. The college's own site publishes a course listing covering analytical chemistry, medical engineering at certificate and diploma level, emergency medical technology, an artisan caregiving programme and a diploma in plumbing technology, while the regulator's accredited course table currently carries a single row for Community Health at Level 6 examined by TVET CDACC. A 2026-11-09 refetch of the live course catalogue https://goshencollege.ac.ke/courses-6/ plus the individual pages for analytical chemistry, medical engineering, emergency medical technology and caregiving corroborated the offered programmes but none of the pages names an examining body, so the non-CDACC examination bodies remain unconfirmed rather than guessed. Teaching is supported by laboratories, a library and an advanced simulation laboratory with high-fidelity manikins, complemented by clinical rotations at partner hospitals and community health centres. The institution's managing director, as published on its homepage, is Dr. Joseph Gichuru.

description: Jodan College of Technology is a private TVET institution located at Jodan Towers on Kwame Nkrumah Street in Thika Town, Kiambu County, Kenya. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority registered it on 28 January 2016 under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0028/2016, and the licence remains valid until 15 August 2027. The college is organised into thirteen schools and departments, and its own site publishes programmes spanning engineering, computing and informatics, hospitality, tourism, journalism and media, cosmetology, fashion and garment making, interior design, agriculture, languages, business studies and logistics, and medical, health and social sciences. Its regulator course table carries 58 accredited rows at CDACC levels 3 to 6, while the college separately advertises KNEC higher diploma awards in business management, secretarial management and entrepreneurship development. The college also runs Jodan Driving School and the Jodan Modern Machinery Training Institute as subsidiary training operations, and states that it is accredited by TVETA, KNEC, CDACC, NITA, KHPOA and international bodies including City and Guilds, ICM, ABMA and ICDL.

description: The Karen Hospital Medical Training College (TKHMTC) is a private medical training college registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0096/2017, with a licence valid to 2 July 2029. It is the training arm associated with The Karen Hospital and positions itself around three pillars of academic excellence, professionalism and discipline, with a vision of becoming a model faculty for competent healthcare professionals in Kenya and beyond. Its published programmes are the Diploma in Kenya Registered Nursing (three years), the Diploma in Peri-operative Theatre Technology (two years), the Higher Diploma in Cardiology (18 months), the Higher Diploma in Cardiopulmonary Perfusion (two years) and a Community Health course, supplemented by Basic and Advanced Life Support short courses. The TVETA register of accredited programmes lists four additional CDACC qualifications in business management and community health at Levels 4, 5 and 6. The college displays accreditation marks for the Nursing Council of Kenya, TVET CDACC, HELB and LEAP on its website, and its published contact line is 0727 254222, with a second line on 0709 382086 and a postal address of P.O. Box 74240-00200.

description: Mt. description: The Kenya Methodist University TVET Institute is the competence-based training arm of Kenya Methodist University, operating from the university's main campus at Kaaga off the Meru-Maua Highway in Meru County, Kenya. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority licensed it as a private Technical and Vocational College on 26 April 2021 under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0042/2021, and its status remains Registered and Licensed with an expiry date of 14 May 2031. Its own programme page lists 46 programmes organised into National Diploma Level 6, Craft Certificate Level 5, Artisan Certificate Level 4 and professional short-course bands, covering business, accountancy, ICT, health records, community health, agriculture, hospitality, maritime logistics, security, sign language and peace and conflict studies. Teaching is offered at the Meru Town Centre, the Meru main campus, the Nairobi campus at KeMU Hub on Monrovia Street, and the Mombasa campus on Narok Road in Buxton, with intakes in January, May and September. The institute also records that its maritime programmes are approved by the Kenya Maritime Authority and that it publishes timetables, a student portal and a digital campus for online study.

about: Petanns Technical Training Institute, also branded Petanns Technical College, is a private Technical and Vocational College in Kiambu Town, Kiambu County, Kenya, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0052/2016 on 28 January 2016 with a licence valid to 19 February 2029. It runs schools of plumbing, fashion design, electrical installation, journalism and media studies, automotive engineering, business and accountancy, hospitality and tourism, cosmetology, information technology and ICDL, and tourism and foreign languages, with a further campus network across Kiambu, Limuru, Nakuru, Thika, Githurai, Ruiru and Kayole.
description: Petanns Technical Training Institute is a private TVET institution headquartered at Petanns Plaza in Kiambu Town, Kiambu County, Kenya. TVETA registered it on 28 January 2016 under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0052/2016, and its licence remains valid until 19 February 2029. The institute is a subsidiary college of Petanns Driving School and Computer College and states that its programmes are examined by KNEC, KASNEB, ICM, NITA, ICDL and IATA. Its own site organises provision into ten schools spanning plumbing, fashion design, electrical installation, journalism and media studies, automotive engineering, business and accountancy, hospitality and tourism, cosmetology, information technology and ICDL, and tourism and foreign languages. Teaching is delivered across a branch network that includes the Kiambu main campus, Limuru, Nakuru, Thika, Githurai 4S, Ruiru and Kayole, each listed with its own telephone line. The regulator's accredited course table currently carries three rows: certified public accountants at professional level under KASNEB, the international certificate of digital literacy under ICDL Africa, and craft secretarial studies under KNEC.

description: Our Lady of Mercy College - Chepareria is a private technical and vocational college at Chepareria, a village in West Pokot County north of Kitale in Kenya's Rift Valley, near the Ugandan border. It is registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0091/2018, registered on 18 July 2018 with a licence valid to 27 November 2028. The college is a ministry of the Congregation of the Sisters of Mercy, whose community was set up at Chepareria in the early 1980s with education as its focus; two Sisters currently serve in the vocational training and artisan centres. The centre caters specifically for young women, including some who only had the chance to attend primary school and others who have escaped from arranged early marriages, and its primary focus is teaching skills for life, particularly tailoring and domestic science, so that students can earn an independent living. Networking with other schools in the area generates income from uniform production, and the college also teaches computer classes. The TVETA register lists six accredited qualifications: KNEC artisan awards in fashion design and garment making and in food and beverage, KNEC craft certificates in food and beverage production and service and in information communication technology, and NITA trade tests in hairdressing and beauty therapy.

description: KMTC Eldoret Campus is a campus of the Kenya Medical Training College, the State Corporation established by an Act of Parliament under the Ministry of Health that trains middle-level health professionals and supplies more than 85 per cent of Kenya's local middle-level health workforce. The college reports 92 campuses in 46 counties, more than 80,000 students and 126 medical courses, with a unified curriculum and harmonised academic programmes and examination procedures across all campuses. The Eldoret campus is listed in KMTC's official campus contacts directory at P.O. Box 520-30100, Eldoret, with its own institutional email address and telephone line, and holds its own branch in the college library catalogue. According to KMTC's 2025/2026 training opportunities bulletin, Eldoret is one of the campuses offering the upgrading Diploma in Community Health Nursing delivered by distance learning, and one of the campuses offering the Higher Diploma in Clinical Medicine and Surgery specialisations in Ear, Nose, Throat, Head and Neck Surgery and in Anesthesia.

description: Kaelo Technical and Vocational College (Kaelo TVC) is a public technical and vocational college at Laare in Igembe North sub-county, Meru County, eastern Kenya. It is registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0037/2018, registered on 12 October 2018 with a licence valid to 24 October 2029. The college's stated mission is to provide quality technical and vocational education that equips trainees with practical skills and knowledge for successful careers and entrepreneurship, and its vision is to be the leading technical and vocational training institution in the region. Its programmes are organised into agriculture and environmental sciences, building and civil engineering, business and entrepreneurial studies, computing and informatics, electrical and electronics, and fashion and design, and it delivers both conventional and dual-training (Dual TVET) modes. The TVETA register lists 42 accredited qualifications covering KNEC craft and diploma awards, NITA trade tests and TVET CDACC competency levels three to six, and the college runs a government-backed Jitume digital laboratory and held its first graduation ceremony in September 2026.

On the TVETA register it appears as KENYA INSTITUTE OF MANAGEMENT - NAROK BRANCH, a private Technical and Vocational College (TVC) registered on 2017-02-16 with licence expiry 2030-11-05 (Registered and Licensed). The TVETA register lists 14 CDACC-examined programmes at the branch, spanning Certificate (Office Assistant, Level 4), Diploma (Level 5) and Higher Diploma (Level 6) tracks in business management, human resource management, marketing, project management, supply chain management, records and archives, and office administration. Students also access KIM's institute-wide Moodle-based virtual learning platform at e-learning.kim.ac.ke and a dedicated online branch, while the parent institute reports over 8,000 members and more than 70,000 graduates.

description: Njabini Agricultural Training Centre is a public Vocational Training Centre in Njabini town, Nyandarua County, registered with TVETA under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0016/2023 (registered 2023-10-09, licence valid to 2028-10-08). Registered and licensed by TVETA in 2023 (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0032/2023), it offers hands-on training with industry exposure and runs TVETA-approved KNEC diploma programmes in Tourism Management and Banking and Finance alongside its media curricula.
description: Imani Digital Learning Centre (IDLC) is a private technical and vocational college located in Kitale, Trans Nzoia County, in Kenya's Rift Valley region. The TVETA register lists it as a private TVC, registration TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0032/2023, registered on 4 May 2023 with the licence running to 3 May 2028, and offers two KNEC diploma programmes: Tourism Management and Banking and Finance. The parent ministry's own website describes IDLC as 'a prestigious journalism school within Imani Radio and TV Ministries' whose comprehensive programmes equip aspiring journalists with the skills and knowledge for the media industry, delivered at a state-of-the-art facility with experienced faculty and hands-on training, with a January intake ongoing. The centre sits within the wider Imani Radio and TV Ministries operation in Kitale, whose head office is P.O Box 669, Kitale, Trans Nzoia County; the ministry publishes head-office contact lines (info@imaniradio.org, +254713093354) but no dedicated centre-owned website, email or phone. Despite the 'Digital Learning' name, neither the register nor the parent site publishes any e-learning platform or distance-learning provision for the centre.

about: Bishop Njuguna Training College is a private technical and vocational college in Thika, Kiambu County, Kenya, licensed by the TVET Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0095/2024 and founded in November 2023 as the diocesan training centre of the ACK Diocese of Thika for clergy, laity and other professionals.
description: Bishop Njuguna Training College was established in November 2023 by the Rt. Rev. Prof. Julius Wanyoike as the diocesan training centre of the ACK Diocese of Thika, became a registered TVET institution in 2024 and was licensed as a Technical and Vocational College under TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0095/2024, registered on 1 August 2024 with a licence running to 1 November 2030. The campus is on the Thika-Garissa Road at Makongeni, opposite ACK St. Luke's Church, in Thika, Kiambu County. The college's own catalogue, captured while its domain was still serving, published nineteen programmes with a stated award level and examination body: KNEC diplomas and certificates in business, human resource, housekeeping, project management, tourism, leadership, sales and procurement; CDACC awards in chaplaincy and theology; ICM hospitality management; and St. Paul's University degrees in education, counselling psychology, community development and community health development, alongside an SPU diploma in higher education instructional design and teaching. The same catalogue also advertised a set of non-credit short courses, among them computer application packages, mediation, Kenyan Sign Language, English communication and writing skills, training of trainers, TOEFL/IELTS preparation, consistent Bible reading and mission studies, none of which carries a TVET award level, so they are recorded here in prose rather than as qualification rows. The TVET Authority register publishes no accredited course list for this registration number, which is not evidence that the college teaches none, so the catalogue rows are retained rather than emptied. The college's domain, bishopnjugunatraining.co.ke, did not resolve when fetched during this pass, and no e-learning, distance-learning or enrolment figure is published on any source fetched.

description: St. Joseph's Vocational Training Center - Mlolongo is a privately owned vocational training centre in Machakos County, in Kenya's Eastern region, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/VTC/0011/2017. description: Diani Vocational Training Center is a public vocational training centre in Kwale County, in Kenya's Coast region, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0028/2017. A 2026-11-09 fetch of TVETA's magazine The TVET Eye issue 004 (https://www.tveta.go.ke/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/THE-TVETA-EYE-2023-issue-4-final.pdf) additionally features 'Diani Vocational Training Center' among institutions raising revenue from Income Generating Activities, an independent regulator publication corroborating active operation. about: Medprime Training College is a private healthcare training college registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0031/2024, with its main campus at MedPrime Towers in Westlands, Nairobi, and regional branches in Eldoret, Kisumu, Meru, Mombasa, Nakuru and Thika.
description: Medprime Training College was registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 25 April 2024 under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0031/2024, and the regulator's register shows its licence valid to 24 April 2029 with the status 'Registered and Licensed'. The regulator lists five accredited programme entries: community health and caregiving at Level 4 and perioperative theatre technology at Level 5, all assessed by TVET CDACC; child protection at Level 6, also assessed by TVET CDACC; and a Social Work and Community Development diploma examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council. The college's own website presents it as a healthcare training provider offering diploma, professional short and short certification programmes with hospital attachments and a Learning and Assessment Centre, and lists programmes including clinical medicine, pharmaceutical technology, sonography, mortuary science, medical laboratory science and nutrition and dietetics, without publishing an award level for each. Its contact page gives the main campus as MedPrime Towers, Woodvale Grove 33, Westlands, Nairobi, with the telephone number +254 729 558 209 and the e-mail address info@medprime.ac.ke, and names regional campuses in Eldoret, Kisumu, Meru, Mombasa, Nakuru and Thika. The college is private and is placed by the regulator in Nairobi County.

The institute states that its courses have been developed in liaison with TVET CDACC and relevant industry stakeholders, with minimum entry of D (plain) for certificate programmes and C- (minus) for diploma programmes. Training is supported by field facilities including a fish farm at the Inland Waters and Wetlands Research Center on the shores of Lake Naivasha, where students of the Diploma in Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences and the Certificate in Aquaculture carry out practical work. The institute also operates research centres, a conference and camping facility at Hippo Campsite, and Naivasha Wildlife Sanctuary. Official contacts published on the institute's website are P.O. Box 842-20117 Naivasha, telephone +254 700 000 321 and +254 731 919 465, and email wrti@wrti.go.ke. about: Karumo Technical Training Institute (KTTI) is a public technical and vocational college in Kianjai, Meru County, Eastern Kenya. It offers competency-based training accredited by TVET CDACC across ICT, building and civil engineering, electrical engineering, agriculture, hospitality, fashion, cosmetology and business, and also runs KASNEB professional courses, Dual TVET apprenticeships and Recognition of Prior Learning pathways.
description: Karumo Technical Training Institute is a public TVET institution located at Kianjai in Meru County, Eastern Kenya, and describes itself as celebrating ten years of service. Its published course catalogue lists 75 programmes, the large majority accredited by TVET CDACC, spanning ICT and cybersecurity, building technology, civil engineering, electrical and electronics engineering, agriculture and environmental studies, hospitality and tourism, fashion and design, and cosmetology. The institute also advertises KASNEB professional qualifications, a Dual TVET programme built around industry-based apprenticeships, and Recognition of Prior Learning for experienced workers. Contact details are published on its website as P.O. Box 276-60602 Kianjai, Meru, telephone +254 (0)705 636 443 and email info@karumotti.ac.ke. Enrolment figures and campus affiliations are not published on the pages fetched, so those fields are recorded as null.

about: Kaimosi Friends University (KAFU) is a public university at Kaimosi in Vihiga County, Western Kenya, founded on Quaker values and describing itself as the Spring of Knowledge. It teaches across five schools - Business and Economics, Computing and Information Technology, Education and Social Sciences, Health Sciences, and Science - offering undergraduate, masters and doctoral programmes including one of only two Kenyan optometry programmes taught to PhD level.
description: Kaimosi Friends University is a public university headquartered at Kaimosi in Vihiga County, Western Kenya, with a published academic catalogue of 39 undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across five schools. Its main campus is at Kaimosi, and it also operates the Kobujoi Campus in Aldai Constituency, Nandi County, opened in September 2025, and the Vokoli Campus in Vihiga County. Teaching spans business and economics, computing and information technology, education and social sciences, health sciences and pure and applied sciences, with health sciences highlighted as one of only two Kenyan institutions offering optometry to PhD level. The university publishes an e-learning platform and a Directorate of Open, Distance and E-Learning that delivers programmes to distance learners. Official contact details are +254 777 373 633 and info@kafu.ac.ke, and the site states that programmes are fully accredited by the Commission for University Education. Enrolment totals are not published as a figure and are recorded as null.

about: Surfcrest Technology Training Institute (STTI) is a private technical and vocational college on the Northern Bypass at Kahawa West in Nairobi County, Kenya. It is registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0098/2025, a licence granted on 25 April 2025 and valid to 24 April 2030. The institute delivers competency-based training across cosmetology, hospitality, ICT, business, social sciences, engineering and foreign languages.
description: Surfcrest Technology Training Institute (STTI) is a private TVET institution established, registered and licensed under the TVET Act, operating from a campus at Kahawa West next to La Phila on the Northern Bypass in Nairobi. The TVET Authority register records it as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0098/2025, registered on 25 April 2025 with a licence running to 24 April 2030 and a status of Registered and Licensed. The regulator's course table lists ten accredited competence-based programmes, one at Level 3, four at Level 4 and five at Level 5, all examined by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council, across front office, accommodation, caregiving, cosmetology, electrical installation, business management, food and beverage, ICT, social work and catering. The institute's own website states that it runs six schools and that it is also approved and registered by KNEC, NITA and CDACC. It publishes the telephone lines 0743093259 and 0737473037 and the email address info@surfcrestttinstitute.ac.ke; no e-learning or distance-learning portal is published.

about: Kapenguria Institute of Business Studies and Technology (KIBST) is a private TVET college in Kapenguria town, West Pokot County, Rift Valley, registered by TVETA under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0005/2021. It runs short, artisan, certificate, diploma and advanced diploma courses across eleven schools and is a KNEC, HRMPEB and KISEB examination centre.
description: Kapenguria Institute of Business Studies and Technology is a private TVET institution in Kapenguria town, West Pokot County, situated on the Kapenguria-Lodwar highway at the Africa Gospel Church Kapenguria grounds. Its website states that it is fully registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0005/2021, and that it is a KNEC, HRMPEB and KISEB examination centre. The institute publishes a 41-entry course catalogue covering business and accountancy, secretarial studies, supply chain management, human resource management, information and communication technology, agriculture, electrical and electronics, journalism and mass media, fashion and cosmetology, social work, health records, nutrition and dietetics, plus KASNEB professional programmes and short courses. Teaching is organised across eleven schools including social work and community development, counselling and psychology, business education, computing and information technology, applied and health sciences, accounts and finance, hospitality management, information science, engineering and electrical, cosmetology and beauty therapy, and public administration and governance. Published contacts are +254 708 756 885, info@kibst.ac.ke and AGC Grounds, Kapenguria; the imported database record carried a different telephone number (0713 365763) which is not published on the college's current contact page, so the website number is recorded here. Enrolment totals are not published and are recorded as null.

description: Delhi College is a private technical college operating from Eastleigh 12th Street in Nairobi County, describing itself as established in 2021 and registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0100/2021. The regulator's register snapshot of 24 October 2026 records that registration with an expiry date of 21 October 2026 and a status of 'Expired', and consequently publishes no accredited course list for the college; the licence therefore lapsed three days before this research run. The college's own website nonetheless advertises more than twenty programmes across six academic departments — business and accounting, health sciences, social sciences, journalism, hospitality and languages, and ICT — and publishes per-programme level tables only on the individual fee pages. Because level and examining body are confirmed from a fetched page only for Business Management (KNEC Certificate and Diploma, plus TVET CDACC Business Administration Certificate and Diploma), only those four qualifications are itemised in context.courses; the remaining programme titles are recorded in this narrative without level or exam body rather than guessed. The college publishes the e-mail address delhicollege04@gmail.com and the telephone +254 729 517 551, and its fee page advertises 'Day, Evening, Distance & Online' study as a flexible option, but no ODeL or e-learning portal URL is published, so the distance and e-learning modes are recorded as implied rather than verified. The town string inherited from the source database is a Google Maps plus-code on General Wairungi Road, which conflicts with the Eastleigh address published by the college; the published address is used here and the inherited value is recorded as a discrepancy.

about: Steps Healthcare Training Institute is a private healthcare training college in the Emory Hospital Building at Kahawa Sukari, Nairobi County, Kenya. It is registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0087/2024 and trains nursing assistants, caregivers and counselling and home-care practitioners under certificate and TVET CDACC competency-based levels.
description: Steps Healthcare Training Institute is a private healthcare training provider operating from the Emory Hospital Building on the third floor at Kahawa Sukari in Nairobi County. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority registered it on 15 May 2024 under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0087/2024, and the register snapshot of 24 October 2026 records the licence as valid to 14 May 2029 with the status 'Registered and Licensed'. The regulator lists four accredited qualifications: a Certified Nursing Assistant certificate examined by Health Logic LLC Examiners and Consultants, Counselling Psychology and Home Care Management at Level 5 of the TVET CDACC framework, and Counselling Psychology at Level 6. The institute's website describes itself as TVET CDACC accredited, ACTD accredited and offering American Heart Association certified Basic Life Support, and it publishes the telephone number +254 769 611811 together with an online admissions portal; no institutional e-mail address is published on a fetched page, so basic_info.email is null. The institute advertises healthcare support service training at Level 5 and a Level 4 caregiver course on its site, which correspond to the CDACC levels recorded here. No e-learning or distance-learning portal is published: the only online service is an enrolment portal, so both learning-mode fields are recorded as none.

about: Nyaore Vocational Training Center is a public vocational training centre in Kisii County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0014/2019. The centre delivers NVCET certificate programmes examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council across agri-business, building, electrical, garment-making, food processing, hairdressing, ICT, leatherwork and metalwork trades.
description: Nyaore Vocational Training Center appears in the TVET Authority register as a public Vocational Training Centre in Kisii County with registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0014/2019, registered on 14 January 2019 and recorded on the register snapshot of 24 October 2026 as 'Registered and Licensed' with the licence running to 22 September 2030. The register publishes twelve programme entries for the centre: ten NVCET certificate programmes examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council covering agri-business, carpentry and joinery, building technology, electrical and electronics technology, fashion design and garment making, food processing technology, hairdressing and beauty therapy, information communication technology, tannery and leatherwork technology and metal processing technology, plus Electrical Installation at TVET CDACC competency levels 3 and 4. The same historical snapshot lists eleven NAVCET entries including MVM, which are historical leads and are not treated as contradiction; the ten registered NVCET programmes and the CDACC levels are preserved unchanged. No institutional website, e-mail address, telephone number, street address or town for the centre could be confirmed on any fetched source, so basic_info.website, basic_info.email, basic_info.phone and basic_info.location.town are null; the plus-code address inherited from the source database is not reproduced because it could not be verified against any fetched page. The centre publishes no facilities list, no student population and no evidence of e-learning or distance-learning delivery.

The institute offers courses across Accounting and Finance (including KASNEB qualifications such as CAMS, ATD, CPA and CIFA), Management (business management, sales and marketing, clearing and forwarding, human resource management, purchasing and supplies, and maritime management), ICT, and Cisco networking. It also operates a Cisco Networking Academy offering CCNA, IT Essentials and cybersecurity tracks, alongside bespoke consultancy and training services. The institute states that its faculty combines industry experts with seasoned educators and that it provides state-of-the-art facilities for hands-on learning.

description: Dermal Training Institute (DTI) is a private training institution on Muthithi Road in Nairobi that specialises in skin science, aesthetics, beauty therapy and wellness education. It is registered and licensed by TVETA as a private technical and vocational college (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0184/2025) and is an approved VTCT Skills (iTEC) centre offering internationally recognised beauty and aesthetics qualifications. Training integrates classroom theory with active clinical practice so students gain real-world client experience, and study is offered full-time, part-time or at weekends. Its portfolio spans iTEC-approved programmes in anatomy and physiology, holistic massage and beauty specialism, alongside DTI certificates in nail technology, makeup artistry, reflexology, microshading, eyelash extensions, advanced diagnostic skin analysis and cosmetic chemistry. The institute also delivers corporate spa training packages such as the Quick-Start Program for New Hires, spa foundation training, spa safety and compliance, and customer experience and service excellence.

about: Endebess Technical Training Institute is a public, TVETA-registered technical and vocational college (TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0013/2023) in Endebess, Trans Nzoia County, offering Level 6, Level 5, Level 4 and Level 3 courses in agriculture, applied sciences, engineering, business and ICT.
description: Endebess Technical Training Institute is a public technical and vocational college located in Endebess, Trans Nzoia County, registered and licensed by TVETA under TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0013/2023. According to the principal, Mr Daniel Kakusha Kamatei, the institute offers Level 6 (Diploma), Level 5 (Craft), Level 4 and Level 3 (Artisan) courses in agriculture, applied sciences, engineering, business and ICT, all framed as competence-based, practically oriented training. The principal's message reports strong KNEC examination performance, rising from 54% in November 2018 to 86% in November 2019, and states that students are supervised and assessed during compulsory industrial attachment. The institute maintains an online admission portal, online fee payment via eCitizen and a Moodle-based e-learning portal at elearning.endebesstechnical.ac.ke, and is listed by KUCCPS for government-sponsored placement.

The institution has since evolved into a major technical institution offering programs through 13 schools and multiple campuses across Kenya. Its vision is to be the premier source for education, workforce training, partnerships, and economic development in East Africa, while its mission is to inspire, prepare, and empower students to succeed in a changing world. description: Uriri Technical and Vocational College is a public Technical and Vocational College in Migori County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0018/2022, registered on 31 October 2022 with the licence running to 30 October 2027. The college operates an official website at https://www.uriritvc.ac.ke/, which states that its programmes are accredited by TVETA and assessed and certified by TVET CDACC under the competency-based education and training framework, that it runs 80 accredited programmes across 11 departments with three intakes a year, and that it partners with KUCCPS and HELB. Its contact page publishes the address Off Rongo-Migori along Oyani Bware Road, P.O. Box 1255-40400 Suna, Migori, the telephone and WhatsApp line +254 793 974 670, the institutional inbox info@uriritvc.ac.ke and the admissions address registrar@uriritvc.ac.ke, and places the campus in Uriri Constituency, Migori County. The same site names Mr. Jared Ogot as Principal and Secretary General of KATTI, and records Hon. Mark Nyamita, Member of Parliament for Uriri Constituency, as founder. The register's KNEC artisan, craft and diploma rows remain the accredited-award record for the institution, while the college's current published catalogue is built on the modularised CDACC curriculum, which it says replaced the older programme structure from 2026.

description: Meru Institute of Business Studies (MIBS College) is a private TVET college of entrepreneurship operating from the Coop-Bank Makutano Building on the third floor in Meru Makutano, Meru County. The college publishes additional campuses in Meru town and Isiolo town, and advertises an open distance and e-learning option alongside its campus-based teaching. It is registered and licensed by TVETA under TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0077/2018, with registration dated 12 October 2018 and a licence running to 2 July 2029. The accredited programme inventory on the TVETA register covers craft certificate and diploma programmes in business management, information communication technology, sales and marketing, and supply chain management, all examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council. The college publishes the contact line +254 720 967249 and the inbox info@meruinstitute.ac.ke on its live site.

The same historical snapshot lists two NITA trade-test entries (fashion design and garment making, carpentry and joinery), which are historical leads and are not treated as contradiction; the three registered artisan trades above are preserved unchanged. No institutional website or published e-mail address is available and student numbers, facilities and satellite campuses are not published, so those fields remain null or empty.

about: KMTC Kakamega Campus is one of the campuses of the Kenya Medical Training College, the public State Corporation established by an Act of Parliament under the Ministry of Health to train middle-level health professionals. The campus is in Kakamega town, Kakamega County, and its programmes are listed on the KUCCPS placement portal under campus code 4805.
description: KMTC Kakamega Campus is a campus of the Kenya Medical Training College, the public State Corporation established by an Act of Parliament under the Ministry of Health to train middle-level health professionals across a national network of campuses. The college's official campus contacts list gives the Kakamega campus postal address as P.O. Box 535-50100 Kakamega, its email as kakamega@kmtc.ac.ke and its telephone lines as 0202400242 and 0796062986. The KUCCPS placement list of KMTC programmes names campus code 4805 (Kakamega) for seven programmes: diplomas in Kenya registered nursing and midwifery, medical laboratory sciences and clinical medicine and surgery, plus certificates in public health, community health assistant, medical emergency technician and orthopedic trauma medicine. KMTC's own news pages also record a graduate who completed the Diploma in Medical Laboratory Sciences at the Kakamega campus in 2024. The examination body for each programme is not stated in any fetched source, so exam_body is recorded as 'unknown' rather than assumed, and campus-level student numbers and facilities are unpublished.

description: Cherished Hope Training College is a private technical and vocational college in Uasin Gishu County. The TVET Authority register lists it as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0148/2024, registered on 29 October 2024 with a licence valid to 28 October 2029, under category TVC and private ownership. Its accredited programme list mixes NITA trade-test artisan courses in tailoring, dressmaking, hairdressing, beauty therapy, electrical wireman work and plumbing and pipe fitting with a KNEC craft course in catering and accommodation operations. The college also holds a CDACC Level 5 qualification in healthcare support services. The regulator publishes no institutional website, postal address, telephone line or email address, so the website, contact and street-address fields are recorded as unknown rather than inferred.

TVETA's own newsletter, The TVET Eye issue 004 (December 2023-May 2024), lists St. Elizabeth Embaro Vocational Training Center among the registered Nyamira County institutions on its county roster. The regulator publishes no telephone line, email address or institutional website for the centre, so those fields are recorded as unknown rather than guessed.

about: Nakuru College of Commerce and Hospitality is a private technical and vocational college housed at Equator House on Kenyatta Lane in Nakuru town, Nakuru County. It is registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0049/2019, registered on 31 July 2019 with a licence valid to 25 September 2029. Teaching is organised into schools of hospitality, tourism, business studies, ICT, fashion and design, hairdressing and beauty therapy, and languages.
description: Nakuru College of Commerce and Hospitality is a private TVET college operating from Equator House on Kenyatta Lane in Nakuru town, next to Ereto Bookshop. The TVET Authority register records it as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0049/2019, registered on 31 July 2019, licensed to 25 September 2029 and marked Registered and Licensed, but the regulator's course table lists no accredited programmes for the institution. The college's own website states that it is registered by the Ministry of Education and recognised by TVETA, and that it runs KNEC diploma, certificate and artisan programmes in hospitality, fashion design, tourism, business, ICT and pastry, plus NITA-accredited skills training in hairdressing, beauty, fashion design and electrical installation. Its published departmental course tables list KNEC certificate and diploma programmes in sales and marketing, supply chain management, human resource management, business management, secretarial studies, catering and accommodation, and food and beverage production and service, alongside ICM diplomas in front office administration, housekeeping and accommodation, and customer service. Study options are advertised as morning, regular, evening and distance learning classes; the site publishes no learning-management-system portal, so distance learning is recorded as implied rather than verified. The college publishes the telephone lines +254 727 424 698 and +254 721 582 532 and the email address Info@nakurucollege.ac.ke, and names Dr. Peninah Ng'ang'a as Director, Lucy Benny as Principal and Mr. Dominic Kereni as Academic Registrar on its About page, though no individual email or telephone number is published for any of them.

about: Kaimosi Friends Vocational Training Center is a public vocational training centre in Vihiga County, Kenya. It is registered and licensed by the TVET Authority as a VTC and offers KNEC national vocational certificates in agri-business, carpentry, electrical and electronics technology, fashion design and food processing technology.
description: Kaimosi Friends Vocational Training Center is a public vocational training centre in Vihiga County. The TVET Authority register records it as TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0094/2017, registered on 12 October 2017 with a licence valid to 19 August 2029, under category VTC and public ownership. Its accredited programmes are five KNEC National Vocational Certificates covering agri-business, appropriate carpentry and joinery, electrical and electronics technology, fashion design and garment making, and food processing technology. Vihiga County's own news site (August 2026) reports that an ABDP/NORAD-ARNSA implementation support mission visited aquaponics construction at this centre, independent county-government confirmation that the centre is operational; the county profile on vihiga.go.ke's education pages additionally documents that it started in 1983 as a church-managed youth polytechnic and was taken over by government in 2009. The centre shares its Kaimosi location with the separately registered Kaimosi Friends National Polytechnic, which appears elsewhere in the same regulator register; no formal affiliation between the two is published. The regulator publishes no street address, postal address, telephone line, email address or institutional website for the centre, so those fields are recorded as unknown.

about: Migori Institute of Beauty and Professional Studies (MIBPS) is a private TVETA-registered technical and vocational college in Migori town, Nyanza, Kenya. It offers excellent technical, research, entrepreneurship and employable skills, empowering graduates for self-sustainability, with Diploma, Certificate, Artisan and Proficiency courses in beauty, hairdressing, catering, ICT and related fields.
description: Migori Institute of Beauty and Professional Studies (MIBPS) is a private technical and vocational college registered and licensed by TVETA under registration TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0096/2021. The college states that it offers excellent technical, research, entrepreneurship and employable skills by empowering graduates for self-sustainability. Its programme portfolio spans Diploma, Certificate, Artisan and Proficiency courses in fields such as beauty therapy, hairdressing, food and beverage production and sales, catering services, salon management, dress making and fashion design, ICT and journalism and media studies. In 2024 the Rotary Club of Suna Migori, in partnership with Rotary International, sponsored a one-year training of 100 young women at the college, funding bakery equipment, electric sewing machines and beauty therapy tools. The institution also operates a public-facing MIBPS Barber and Spa in Migori town that serves as a dual learning and commercial training site for its students.

description: Kaaleng Vocational Training Center is a public vocational training centre in Turkana County. The TVET Authority register lists it as TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0053/2017, registered on 19 June 2017 with a licence valid to 25 January 2028, under category VTC and public ownership. Its accredited programmes are seven NITA trade-test artisan courses covering electrical wireman work, hairdressing, masonry, motor vehicle mechanics, tailoring, dressmaking and beauty therapy. Turkana County's own website article of 13 May 2024 ('Turkana TVET trainers equipped to boost competency-based education implementation'), preserved by the Internet Archive capture of 21 March 2025, lists the county's vocational training institutions as operating in Lodwar, Lokichar, Lokichoggio, Lokori, Kataboi, Lorgum and Kaaleng-Kaikor, catering to roughly 5,500 county trainees, which identifies the Kaaleng-Kaikor locality as this county institution's host area. Because no official source publishes a town or street address for the centre itself, the town field is kept as 'unknown'. The regulator publishes no street address, postal address, telephone line, email address or institutional website for the centre, so those fields are recorded as unknown. The source database carried a website address (tetvc.ac.ke) that belongs to Turkana East TVC, a different institution, and it was therefore not carried into the record.

description: Kurgung Vocational Training Center is a public vocational training centre in Nandi County. The TVET Authority register records it as TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0071/2017, registered on 13 July 2017 with a licence valid to 2 July 2029, under category VTC and public ownership. Its accredited programmes are four NITA trade-test artisan courses covering carpentry and joinery, masonry, motor vehicle mechanics and welding and fabrication. Nandi County's own site names 'Kurgung VTC' under Mosop sub-county and its bursary schedule places 'KURGUNG VOCATIONAL TRAINING CENTRE' in Kilibwoni ward, and the county government uses 'Kurgung/Surungai' as a ward name - the centre sits in a locality of the same name, though no authority publishes a town or street address, so the town field stays 'unknown'. No institutional website is published in the register, and none was confirmed during this research; the county's March 2025 digital-equipment rollout article (nandi.go.ke) covers Kiropket, Septonok and Cheptarit VTCs and names neither Kurgung nor any new contact details. The source database's 'Nairobi' town entry for this Nandi County centre was not verified and has not been carried over, while the aggregator phone entries (0714 239769 vs 720976589) conflict and neither is corroborated by an official source.

description: Kanyagia Vocational Training Centre is a public vocational training centre in Nyandarua County, Kenya, recorded in the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority register as registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0005/2023 in the VTC category under public ownership. The register records a registration date of 4 May 2023, an expiry date of 3 May 2028 and a registration status of 'Registered and Licensed'. The TVETA register of accredited programmes lists three qualifications at the centre, all examined by the National Industrial Training Authority at trade test level: computer operator, tailoring and dressmaking. The centre publishes no institutional website, and no official telephone number or email address for the institution was located in the regulator's register or in the institution's own published material, so those fields are recorded as null rather than estimated. Its programme profile indicates a small community-scale vocational centre focused on garment-making trades and basic computer operation rather than a broad technical college portfolio.

description: Gitero Vocational Training Centre is a public vocational training centre located in Gitero, Nyeri Central Sub-County, Nyeri County, Central Region, Kenya. The TVET Authority register lists it under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0147/2018 (registered 12 November 2018, licence valid to 11 November 2028) as a public VTC offering NITA-examined artisan courses in Carpentry and Joinery, Dressmaking, Hairdressing and Beauty Therapy, Masonry, and Tailoring. The County Government of Nyeri Directorate of Youth Affairs and Vocational Training independently lists Gitero Vocational Training Centre under Nyeri Central Sub-County on its official Youth Polytechnics directory. description: Auscare International College publishes eight awards on its own course catalogue, each naming its qualification level in the title: diplomas in community health nursing, community health and development, community services, and social work and development; certificates in community health and development, social work and development, and health care assistance; and a Community Health Assistant artisan programme. It delivers competency-based business, information technology, counselling, hospitality, culinary and social work programmes assessed by the TVET CDACC, and its website lists the Association of Sisterhoods of Kenya among its founding partners.
description: Chemichemi ya Uzima College is a private TVET institution in Nairobi County, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 9 October 2023 under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0097/2023, with an expiry date of 28 October 2029 and a register status of 'Registered Only' rather than 'Registered and Licensed'. The college describes its purpose as preparing professionals in technical education through market-relevant training, ethics and practical mastery, and it states that it combines hands-on technical training with leadership development supported by laboratories, ICT facilities and a library. The TVETA register of accredited programmes records thirteen qualifications, all assessed by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council, comprising Level 4 artisan training in food production and culinary arts, Level 5 certificate programmes in business management, human resource management, information communication technology, supply chain management, food production (culinary arts) and social work, and Level 6 diploma programmes in accountancy, business management, counselling psychology, human resource management, information communication technology and social work. Its website lists TVET CDACC, the Kenya Conference of Catholic Bishops, the Association of Sisterhoods of Kenya, ACWECA, the Catholic University of East Africa and Tangaza University as partners and affiliations, and it names Sr. Luciana Wanyahoro as the college director. Contact details published on the college site are the telephone number +254 714 874 335, the admissions email enrolment@aoskenya.org, a departmental directory with separate registrar and finance addresses, and a staff portal hosted at staffportal.aoskenya.org.

It operates a live learning management system at elearning.uwezocollege.ac.ke which advertises study from any location with 24/7 portal access, and the college's FAQ states that it delivers training by face-to-face, online, part-time and distance-learning modes. Teaching is organised across schools of ICT, business management, electrical engineering, catering and hospitality, social and community development, building and construction, cosmetology, accounting, education, culture and social studies, and fashion and design. Contact details published on the e-learning platform are the telephone numbers +254724390322 and +254713554972, the email address uwezocollege@gmail.com and the address Machakos Town, Industrial Area, KIE Building; the main website domain uwezocollege.ac.ke returned an HTTP 500 error when fetched during this research while the e-learning subdomain responded normally.

description: Kamel Park Training College, which brands itself KAPATCO, is a private TVET institution on the Kisii-Kilgoris road in Kisii County, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 25 April 2025 under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0075/2025, with a licence recorded as valid to 24 April 2030 and a status of 'Registered and Licensed'. The college states its mission as delivering vocational education that equips students with practical skills tailored to industry demands, and it says its programmes span business, information technology, health sciences and creative arts, with an emphasis on experiential learning and internships. The TVETA register of accredited programmes records thirteen qualifications at the institution, all assessed by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council: Level 4 programmes in baking and fashion design technology; Level 5 programmes in fashion design technology, food and beverage operations, information communication technology and tour guiding; and Level 6 diploma programmes in broadcast journalism, business management, food and beverage management, human resource management, information communication technology, marketing, and tour and travel management. The college publishes the telephone lines +254 755 386 594 and +254 753 915 354 and the email address info@kamelparkcollege.co.ke, and it operates an online application status tracker. Its website describes the institution as recognised by the Kenyan Ministry of Education and states that all its courses are accredited by TVETA and other recognised bodies; no e-learning, learning-management-system or distance-learning platform is published, so both learning-mode fields are recorded as none.

description: Mwatate Medical Training Institute is a private TVET institution in Taita Taveta County, Kenya, recorded in the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority register as registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0035/2025 in the TVC category under private ownership. The register records a registration date of 29 January 2025, an expiry date of 28 January 2030 and a registration status of 'Registered and Licensed'. The TVETA register of accredited programmes lists three qualifications at the institute, all competency-based social work programmes assessed by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council at Levels 4, 5 and 6. The TVETA register publishes only the county in which the institute operates and no street address; the Mwatate locality recorded here is taken from the institution's registered name and has not been confirmed against a published postal address. No institutional website, email address or telephone number for the institute was located in the regulator's register or an institutional source, so those fields are recorded as null rather than estimated. Despite its medical-training name, the regulator's accredited programme list at the time of research records only social work qualifications, and third-party course directories listing additional health, food and beverage, ICT and trade-test programmes could not be corroborated against the TVETA register.

The KMTC library catalogue records the campus address as post office box 148, Oyugis 40222, Kenya, with the telephone number 0748034396, and the college's published campus contacts list gives the campus email address rachuonyo@kmtc.ac.ke. description: St Kizito Vocational Training Institute - Githurai was registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 14 January 2019 under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/VTC/0008/2019, and the regulator's register shows its licence valid to 2 July 2029 with the status 'Registered and Licensed'. The regulator lists eight accredited programme entries, spanning artisan courses examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council, a craft certificate in electrical and electronics technology, trade-test motor vehicle mechanics assessed by the National Industrial Training Authority, and Level 4 competency-based programmes in instrumentation and control and in welding assessed by TVET CDACC. The institute's own website publishes its academic programmes, stating that automotive technology is examined at CDACC Level 4 and at NITA grades III, II and I, and it names its main campus at Githurai 45, Mwihoko and a branch campus at Roysambu opposite TRM Drive. The site gives the institute's main telephone line as +254724-238716 and its e-mail address as info@stkizito.ac.ke. The institute is private, belongs to the Archdiocese of Nairobi and sits in Kiambu County within Kenya's Central region.

description: Kensal Beauty and Fashion College is a private TVET institution in Kisumu County, Kenya, recorded in the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority register as registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0022/2024 in the TVC category under private ownership. The register records a registration date of 25 April 2024, an expiry date of 24 April 2029 and a registration status of Registered and Licensed. The TVETA register of accredited programmes lists a single qualification at the college, hairdressing and beauty therapy at National Vocational Certificate level, examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council. The college publishes the telephone number 0732 400526, and the institutional website kensal.co.ke returned an HTTP 500 internal server error when fetched during this research, so no website content could be used to corroborate further details; no official email address was located in the regulator register or an institutional source and that field is recorded as null. The college social media page refers to additional short-course offerings in nail technology, barbering and make-up, but those are not reflected in the regulator accredited programme list and are therefore not recorded as accredited courses. Its accredited programme profile is a single cosmetology qualification rather than a broad technical portfolio.

description: Chevaywa Technical Training Institute is a public TVET institution in Kakamega County, Kenya, recorded in the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority register as registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0003/2022 in the TVC category under public ownership. The register records a registration date of 27 January 2022, an expiry date of 26 January 2027 and a registration status of 'Registered and Licensed'. The TVETA register of accredited programmes records twelve entries at the institute, covering competency-based information communication technology qualifications at Levels 4, 5 and 6 and masonry qualifications at Levels 3 and 4, all assessed by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council; the register repeats several entries, so five distinct course-and-level combinations are recorded here. The institute publishes the telephone number 0716 591952, but no institutional website or email address was located in the regulator's register or an institutional source, so those fields are recorded as null rather than estimated. The TVETA register publishes only the county in which the institute operates and no street address; the Chevaywa locality recorded here is taken from the institution's registered name and has not been confirmed against a published postal address. Its accredited programme profile is narrow, concentrated on ICT and masonry trades rather than a broad engineering portfolio.

about: Kacheliba Technical Training Institute (Kacheliba TTI), which brands itself KTVC, is a government-owned public Technical and Vocational College in Kodich, Kapenguria, West Pokot County, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0026/2025. It trains in competency-based education and training from Level 3 artisan modules through Level 6 diplomas, states that it is recognised as a Centre of Excellence in Building and Civil Engineering, and positions its semi-arid northern Rift Valley setting as a base for climate-smart agriculture, water and green-technology training.
description: Kacheliba Technical Training Institute is a public TVC in West Pokot County, registered by TVETA under TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0026/2025 on 6 November 2025 with a licence running to 5 November 2030 and a status of Registered and Licensed. Its own website publishes the campus address as Kodich, Kapenguria, P.O. Box 201, 30600 Kapenguria, together with the general email info@kachelibatti.ac.ke, an admissions address admission@kachelibatti.ac.ke, a single telephone/WhatsApp line and office hours of Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00. The published catalogue runs to more than forty competency-based programmes across five departments - building and civil engineering, mechanical and automotive engineering, computing/hospitality/fashion, electrical and electronics engineering, and business and liberal studies - all examined by TVET CDACC at Levels 3 to 6, and the institute advertises January, May and September intakes with entry from KCSE mean grade D- for artisan levels to C- for diploma levels. It states that it is accredited by CDACC, the Ministry of Education, KNQA and NITA, and the homepage advertises 300-plus trainees. The regulator's own course table for this registration number currently returns no rows, so the programme list here is taken from the institution's published catalogue rather than from the TVETA register; no e-learning, distance-learning or student portal is published, and no named officer could be verified from a primary source, so personal contacts are left empty.

It was founded by Vitalis Leo, a former MV Uhuru chief engineer and retired Lake Victoria captain, and trains seafarers, fishers and boat crews from two Kisumu campuses: the main campus at Korando Peninsular, off New Airport–Busia Road, and branch training grounds at Rainbow Junction to Ngege Beach, where trainees practise on the water. description: Ugenya Technical and Vocational College is a public TVET institution in Siaya County recorded in the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority register as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0014/2017 in the TVC category under public ownership. An education-news article corroborates the college's location: Sega Township, off Sega-Ukwala Road, approximately 2 kilometres from Sega Township in Siaya County, and describes it as one of the first 70 TVCs established by the Kenyan government, admitting students from September 2018. The same article publishes contact details for the college: phone +254 115 107 907 or +254 765 840 772, email info@utvc.ac.ke or ugenya.techcollege@gmail.com, and an X account @ugenyatvc, and states the college is listed on the KUCCPS website under the Ministry of Education. The register's accredited programme list contains 84 rows; deduplicated to one entry per distinct programme, level and awarding body this yields 43 qualifications: KNEC artisan, craft and diploma programmes plus TVET CDACC competency-based programmes at levels 3 to 6 across agriculture, automotive, building, business, electrical, ICT, mechanical, plumbing, refrigeration, supply chain and welding disciplines. The domain 'utvc.ac.ke' named in the email address and a social-media post did not resolve in DNS at research time, so basic_info.website remains null rather than asserting an unreachable site.

about: Bushiangala Vocational Training Center is a public vocational training centre in Kakamega County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0133/2019, with a licence valid from 15 April 2019 to 2 July 2029. description: Bushiangala Vocational Training Center is a publicly owned vocational training centre in Kakamega County recorded by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0133/2019, registered on 15 April 2019 with a licence valid to 2 July 2029 and a register status of 'Registered and Licensed'. Three independent sources corroborate the centre this run: the TVETA register, a course-listing page that repeats the exact registration number, all six stored NITA trade-test courses and the 2029-07-02 expiry, and an education directory page that publishes the centre's contacts and location: P.O Box 134-504100 Khayega, phone 721802153, Plot KAK/SHIKAHO/1355, Kakamega County. The six accredited trade-test trades are carpentry and joinery, masonry, motor vehicle mechanics, tailoring, welding and fabrication, and dressmaking, all examined by the National Industrial Training Authority at artisan grade. about: The Bureti National Polytechnic is the public TVET institution at Bureti in Cheplanget Ward, Kericho County, formerly Bureti Technical Training Institute and now operating as a National Polytechnic with three campuses. Its official site publishes a course catalog of 65 programmes across eight departments and gives the principal's office, admissions and customer-care contacts.
description: The Bureti National Polytechnic publishes its own website at buretipoly.ac.ke, describing itself as a TVET institution offering competency-based education and training across eight academic departments: agriculture, building and civil engineering, business, electrical and electronics engineering, hospitality, ICT, mechanical and automotive engineering, and a driving school. The course catalog states that the polytechnic runs 65 programmes, with full-time durations of one, two or three years and qualification levels recorded on a CBET scale from Level 4 to Level 6. The contact page gives the main campus as Bureti, Cheplanget Ward, 5.9 km from Sotik Town along the Roret-Sotik road, with the postal address P.O. Box 444-20406, Sotik, and lists two further campuses at Chebwagan (business, cosmetology and beauty therapy) and Tebesonik (agricultural technology and rural development). The site states that the institution is certified under ISO 21001:2025 for educational organisations management systems, and publishes principal@buretipoly.ac.ke and registrar@buretipoly.ac.ke together with the numbers 0742888444 and 0704 453 337. One caution was noted while reading the site: the contact page headline still reads 'The Kericho National Polytechnic', evidently a template artefact, while the rest of the site, the email domain, postal address and telephone number all identify the Bureti institution; the site is therefore accepted as the Bureti domain. Student numbers, campus-level facilities and any named individual officers are not published, so those fields are left null.

about: Kilgoris Technical and Vocational College is a public technical and vocational college in Kilgoris town, Narok County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0005/2025, with a licence valid from 29 January 2025 to 28 January 2030.
description: Kilgoris Technical and Vocational College is a publicly owned technical and vocational college in Narok County recorded by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0005/2025, registered on 29 January 2025 with a licence valid to 28 January 2030 and a register status of 'Registered and Licensed'. The college was opened on 29 September 2023, an occasion presided over by the TVET Principal Secretary Dr. Esther Muoria, and is hosted at the Maasai Mara Technical and Vocational College campus in Kilgoris opposite D.E.B Primary School along the Kilgoris-Kisii highway. The official KUCCPS placement portal lists KILGORIS TVC as a public government college under the Ministry of Education in Narok County, and an education-news article corroborates the college's Kilgoris town location and publishes its contact line +254 799 21 33 00. The regulator's accredited programme list contains six Level 5 competency-based programmes assessed by TVET CDACC, and the KUCCPS-approved course list additionally includes Social Work and Community Development Level 6 and Business Administration Level 6 (TVET CDACC), which are recorded here as sourced current offerings. The register separately lists Kilgoris Vocational Training Center under TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0029/2016 as a distinct institution.

about: Carlile College is a private technical and vocational college in Nairobi County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the TVET Authority under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0005/2017 and operated as an education ministry of Church Army Africa, an Anglican mission society.
description: Carlile College is registered by the TVET Authority as a private Technical and Vocational College under TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0005/2017, first registered on 16 February 2017 with a licence running to 15 August 2027. The college's own website states that it was started by Church Army Africa in 1958 with a group of eight students in evangelism training and began offering diploma training in evangelism in 1995, and it lists Carlile School of Business among its academic departments. The TVET Authority publishes nine programme entries for the college spanning business management, electrical and electronics technology, food and beverage service, social development and electrical installation, at artisan, craft and diploma level. The website gives the campus as situated along Jogoo Road in Nairobi, with telephone +254-722 423397 and email info@carlilecollege.ac.ke, and it links an E-Learn Login portal hosted on a Moodle installation at e-learn.carlilecollege.ac.ke. No student enrolment total, fee schedule or campus facility inventory is published in the sources fetched.

about: Medprime Training College - Mombasa is the Mombasa campus of Medprime Training College, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0242/2025, delivering healthcare training from Medprime Centre on Mwembe Tayari Road in Mombasa County, Kenya.
description: Medprime Training College - Mombasa was registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 6 November 2025 under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0242/2025, and the regulator's register shows its licence valid to 5 November 2030 with the status 'Registered and Licensed'. The regulator publishes no course table against this campus registration, so the campus's accreditation covers the campus itself rather than a separately listed programme set. The college's own website lists the Mombasa campus at Medprime Centre, Mwembe Tayari Road, left off Tawakal Station, and gives the campus telephone line as +254 723 254 257. The college publishes a catalogue of healthcare programmes including clinical medicine, pharmaceutical technology, sonography, perioperative theatre technology, mortuary science and medical laboratory science, and states that diploma and certificate programmes are delivered with hospital attachments and a Learning and Assessment Centre, but it does not publish an award level for each individual programme; the Diploma in Community Health Nursing (DCHN) is the one programme it names with a diploma qualification. The campus belongs to a private TVC placed by the regulator in Mombasa County.

The institution's own website, tvtcentre.ac.ke, presents it as Trident Vocational Training Centre offering NITA-certified plumbing training across six grade levels and states that it is accredited by TVETA and NITA for plumbing training and trade testing. The website describes high-tech workshops, industrial attachment placement and graduation ceremonies in 2025 and 2026, but no street address, email address or telephone number appears on the page fetched, so those fields remain unknown and the three NITA trade test plumbing grades are recorded at artisan level.

description: KMTC Voi Campus appears in the college's official campus contacts directory of February 2026 with postal address P.O. Box 18-80300 Voi and telephone 0705751103. Two campus contact documents published by the College itself print the Voi e-mail address with a malformed domain: the February 2026 register (row 89) and the undated contacts list at https://kmtc.ac.ke/images/document/KMTC-campus-contacts.pdf both show 'voi@kmtc.ac.kew', while the College's campus contacts advert of 9 June 2025 (row 88) prints the same local part with the correct domain as 'voi@kmtc.ac.ke'; that corrected, institution-published form is the address recorded here. The documents also disagree on the postal box, printing 18-80300 in February 2026 against 30-80300 in the 2025 advert and 2025 contacts list, so the address is taken from the newer February 2026 register and the discrepancy is flagged for the owner rather than silently resolved. The KUCCPS placement list of KMTC programmes identifies campus code 5120 (Voi) offering two diplomas and four certificates, covering community health nursing, clinical medicine and surgery, health records and information technology, orthopaedic trauma medicine, community health assistance and medical emergency technology. The campus lies in Voi, Taita Taveta County, which is part of the Coast region. KMTC's academic programmes page confirms the college's certificate, diploma and higher diploma health training and links a central e-learning platform at elearning.kmtc.ac.ke, while the examination body for each programme is not stated in any fetched source and is recorded as unknown.
