description: Makina Vocational Training Center is a public vocational training centre placed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority in Kwale County, Kenya, registered and licensed as TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0079/2018. The regulator's live record for the centre lists four accredited programme entries - Electrical Wireman, Motor Vehicle Mechanics, Tailoring and Dressmaking - all at trade-test level and all examined by the National Industrial Training Authority. Corroborated via local TVETA register snapshot. Registration dates from 2018-04-12 and the licence runs to 2029-07-02 with status 'Registered and Licensed'. No institutional website, e-mail address or telephone line for the centre could be confirmed on any source fetched in this run, so those fields are left null rather than carried over from unverified import data, and no street-level address is published by the regulator. No evidence of e-learning or distance-learning delivery was found.

about: Chuka Technical and Vocational College is a public Technical and Vocational College at Chuka in Tharaka Nithi County, Kenya, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0019/2018. The college opened in January 2018 after being mentored by Chuka University and later by Meru National Polytechnic, and delivers KNEC and TVET CDACC examined artisan, craft and diploma programmes in engineering, business, ICT, agriculture and cosmetology. The TVETA register places the college in Meru County, a legacy administrative label predating the creation of Tharaka Nithi County, while the college itself and this record are located in Tharaka Nithi.
description: Chuka Technical and Vocational College (Chuka TVC) is a public TVET institution established in 2015 as a government project to widen access to technical training in support of Kenya's Vision 2030 industrialisation goals. It was initially mentored by Chuka University, with mentorship later transferred to Meru National Polytechnic, and it admitted its first students in January 2018. The college is registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0019/2018, and the regulator's current course table lists 34 accredited programmes: artisan awards in electrical installation, masonry, plumbing and welding and fabrication; craft/certificate awards in electrical and electronics technology, ICT, mechanical engineering plant and production, secretarial studies and social development; diplomas in building technology, civil engineering, quantity surveying, mechanical and electrical engineering, agriculture, business management, human resource management, ICT, supply chain management and social work and community development, all examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council; and TVET CDACC competency-based programmes at Levels 4 to 6 in cosmetology, ICT, office assistance, land surveying, mechanical production technology, sustainable agriculture and agripreneurship. The college sits about 8 km along the Chuka–Kareni (Kathwana) road, roughly 5 km off Kaanwa market towards Mwanjati, and provides mechanical, building and civil, and electrical engineering workshops, ICT laboratories, agriculture facilities, neighbourhood hostels and a college mess on a pay-as-you-eat basis. The TVETA register records the college's county as Meru, a legacy label from before Tharaka Nithi County was created; the college's published address and this record place it at Chuka in Tharaka Nithi County within the Eastern region, and the divergence is recorded rather than silently reconciled. No e-learning or open distance learning platform is live: the college states that online learning will soon be introduced, so both learning-mode fields are recorded as implied only.

description: Solongo Vocational Training Center was registered by the TVET Authority on 14 July 2016 under TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0115/2016 and holds a licence valid to 25 March 2029. The authority's register places the centre in Kakamega County, and an independent county listing (coursebook.co.ke) likewise places Solongo Vocational Training Center among Kakamega County VTCs. description: Dexter International College was registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 14 July 2016 under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0181/2016, and the licence runs to 2 July 2029 with the status 'Registered and Licensed'. No e-learning or distance-learning provision is published on the regulator page for this college, and no institutional website is shown on that page.

about: Chamasiri Technical and Vocational College is a public technical and vocational college in Busia County, Western Kenya, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0014/2020. Corroborated via local TVETA register snapshot and official domain chamasiritvc.ac.ke. It offers artisan, craft and diploma programmes in agriculture, building, business, ICT and social development.
description: Chamasiri Technical and Vocational College was registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 23 January 2020 and its licence runs to 7 July 2030 with the status 'Registered and Licensed'. Corroborated via local TVETA register snapshot and official domain chamasiritvc.ac.ke. The college sits off the Malakisi-Chamasiri road in Busia County and uses a postal address of P.O. Box 36-50209, Malakisi. The regulator's course table for the college carries fifteen rows, all captured here: artisan awards in general agriculture and plumbing, craft-level programmes in building technology, business management, general agriculture, information communication technology, masonry, plumbing, social development, supply chain management and road construction, and diploma programmes in business management, agriculture, information communication technology and social work and community development, every one of them examined by the Kenya National Examinations Council. The institution's domain chamasiritvc.ac.ke is live and active, and no e-learning or distance-learning provision is published.

about: Spring International Training College (SITC) is a private technical and vocational college in Nairobi, Kenya, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0085/2024 and operating Kilimani, Nairobi CBD and Westlands campuses plus an institution-owned Moodle platform for distance learning.
description: Spring International Training College is a private Technical and Vocational College recorded in the TVETA register under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0085/2024, registered on 15 May 2024 with a licence valid to 14 May 2029 and the status Registered and Licensed, with Nairobi as its county. The regulator's accredited-course table lists a single programme for the college, Information Communication Technology at Craft level examined by KNEC, repeated across three identical rows. The college's own website publishes a wider catalogue than the accredited table, including a Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) course running six months to two years with classroom instruction and supervised clinical practice, a Certificate in Teaching International Curricula delivered online, and further course pages for phlebotomy, digital marketing, graphic design, coding for children and language study for which no qualification level or external examining body is published. For the CNA and CTIC programmes the college does not name an external examining body either, so they are recorded here as institution-examined. It operates three campuses - Kilimani on Rose Avenue near Monarch Hotel, Nairobi CBD at View Park Towers on Utalii Street, and Westlands on Waiyaki Way - and runs a live Moodle site at e-learning.sitc-tvet.ac.ke headed 'Spring International Training College, center for Distance Learning'. Its history page records that the college was founded at Viewpark Towers, Wing B in July 2023 and has since grown to more than 4,000 alumni.

about: The East African Institute of Welding is a private technical and vocational college registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0080/2021 in Kajiado County, Kenya. It trains welders to national TVET CDACC qualifications and to international ISO 9606 certification through the Canadian Welding Bureau, and also offers non-destructive testing, welding inspection and consultancy services.
description: The East African Institute of Welding describes itself as a technical institute working to harmonise the training, examination and qualification testing of welders in the region against International Institute of Welding standards. It delivers competence-based education and training through a dual learning approach, pairing workshop instruction with industrial attachment so that trainees move into workplace training and mid-level manpower roles. Short courses lead to national TVET CDACC qualifications and to international ISO 9606 certification accredited by the Canadian Welding Bureau, with the welding programme presented in three progressive levels described as fillet, plate and pipe welder; trainees quoted on the site report earning the TVET CDACC Level 4 Welding and Fabrication qualification through a six-month dual training programme. Beyond training, the institute offers non-destructive testing, specialised NDT, welding inspection, consultancy and pre- and post-shipment inspection services, describing a regional presence with a head office in Nairobi, Kenya and a branch office in Kampala, Uganda, and a partnership with Quality Control Company of Egypt, an authorised examination centre of the American Society for Non-Destructive Testing. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority register lists it as a private Technical and Vocational College in Kajiado County under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0080/2021, registered on 21 July 2021 with the registration shown as expired on 20 July 2026. The institute's website did not publish a telephone number or email address on the pages fetched, so no phone or email is recorded here.

It trains in computing and informatics, building and civil engineering, cosmetology, fashion and garment making, electrical and electronics, hospitality and tourism, mechanical and automotive engineering, and business and liberal studies.
description: Kibra Technical and Vocational College is registered by the TVET Authority under number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0021/2024, registered on 1 August 2024 with a licence running to 31 July 2029 as a public Technical and Vocational College in Nairobi County. The college's own website, kibratvc.ac.ke, states that it was established in 2024 and organises teaching into eight academic departments: computing and informatics, building and civil engineering, cosmetology, fashion and garment making, electrical and electronics, hospitality and tourism, mechanical and automotive engineering, and business and liberal studies. It publishes its own level structure, describing Level 6 as diploma courses, Level 5 as craft certificate courses, Level 4 as artisan courses and Level 3 as vocational artisan certificate programmes, with short courses in hairdressing, beauty therapy, arc welding, ICT, food production, baking, plumbing, electrical wireman, painting and masonry examined by NITA. The TVET Authority register lists 25 accredited CDACC programme entries at Levels 4, 5 and 6 across business management, cosmetology, electrical installation and engineering, fashion design, food and beverage, ICT, masonry, plumbing, social work and tourism, with duplicate register rows collapsed here. The college publishes a Principal's welcome message from Mrs. Tabitha M. Maina and lists KATTI, HELB, NITA, KUCCPS, the Ministry of Education and the TVET Authority as partners.

about: The Kisumu National Polytechnic is a public National Polytechnic in Kisumu County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the TVET Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/NP/0004/2016. It traces its origins to 1967 and operates under ISO 9001:2015 quality management systems, training artisans, craft and diploma technicians across engineering, applied sciences, business, health and hospitality disciplines. Corroborated via local TVETA register snapshot and the official domain kisumupoly.ac.ke.
description: The TVET Authority register records the polytechnic as a public National Polytechnic registered on 28 January 2016 with a licence valid to 30 October 2027 and a status of Registered and Licensed. Corroborated via local TVETA register snapshot. Its accredited programme table runs to 100 rows which, after de-duplication by course, level and examining body, are recorded here as 81 distinct awards spanning artisan, craft and diploma qualifications examined by KNEC and KASNEB, NVCET vocational certificates examined by KNEC, aquaculture and fisheries qualifications at Levels 3 to 5 awarded by the polytechnic itself, and TVET CDACC competency-based awards at Levels 3 to 6. Register levels are recorded in canonical form: Craft as Certificate, Trade Test as Artisan, Diploma as Diploma, CDACC Levels 3, 4, 5 and 6 as Artisan, Certificate, Diploma and Higher Diploma respectively, and the polytechnic's own Levels 3 to 5 aquaculture and fisheries awards as Artisan, Certificate and Diploma with an internal examining body. The register's KASNEB Certified Public Accountants row is not recorded because the current level enumeration has no professional tier. The institution's own site states that it was founded in 1967, is guided by ISO 9001:2015 and admits students each January, and publishes a Technology Road address next to Kisumu Stadium with postal box 143-40100 Kisumu, the telephone lines (+254) 723 446 773 and (+254) 742 809 415 and the mail address info@kisumupoly.ac.ke. Academic work is organised into eleven schools and departments spanning agriculture, applied sciences, building and civil engineering, business, computing, electrical and electronics, fashion, health sciences, hospitality, liberal studies and mechanical and automotive engineering. The Chief Principal's message describes expansion of Open, Distance and e-Learning platforms and the Jitume digital programme, but no LMS or ODEL portal URL is published, so electronic learning is recorded as implied rather than verified.

about: The International Centre of Technology, branded ICT College Thika, is a private technical and vocational college in Thika, Kiambu County, Kenya. It trains in engineering, information technology, hospitality, cosmetology, community development, occupational health and safety, and emergency and fire services, and is an accredited training and examination centre for the Institution of Fire Engineers of the United Kingdom.
description: The International Centre of Technology, which brands itself ICT College Thika, publishes its address as P.O. Box 3612-01002, Thika, one kilometre from Landless, with the telephone line +254 702 404 322 and the mail addresses inquiries@ict.ac.ke and enquiries@ict.ac.ke. The college's course pages publish the qualification and examining body for each programme: the School of Engineering lists KNEC Craft courses in automotive and electrical engineering together with KNEC artisan courses and NITA grade tests in panel beating and plumbing; the School of Hospitality lists KNEC certificate and diploma courses in food and beverage management alongside ICM certificate, diploma and advanced diploma awards; the community development page lists a KNEC/ABMA certificate and a KNEC diploma in community development and social work; the occupational health and safety page lists ICM certificate and diploma awards; and the cosmetology page lists three NITA-examined beauty therapy and hair dressing courses. Its fire fighting page states that the college is an accredited IFE training and examination centre examining the Level 2 Certificate and Level 3 Diploma, so those two awards are recorded at Certificate and Diploma level. Register-style levels are recorded in canonical form, with Craft as Certificate, artisan and NITA grade tests as Artisan, certificate titles as Certificate, diploma titles as Diploma and the advanced diploma as Higher Diploma. No TVET Authority register row could be located for this institution by name, so TVETA registration is not asserted and the record's accreditation list rests on the college's own published examining bodies; programmes whose pages publish neither a qualification level nor an examining body, including the emergency medical technician course and the disaster management certificate and diploma, are not recorded as awards. The college publishes no campus list, no learning-management-system portal and no enrolment figure, so those fields are recorded as none or null.

The institution, which began training P1, P2 and P3 teachers in May 1967 on a 45-hectare site about 16 km north of Mombasa Island, now runs diploma and certificate programmes in teacher education, business, ICT and social sciences examined by KNEC, KASNEB, NITA, ICM and IBM, and publishes an online student portal.
description: Shanzu Teachers Technical Training College is a public TVET institution in Mombasa County, Coast region, operating along the Mombasa–Malindi road near Shimo La Tewa on a 45-hectare site about 16 km north of Mombasa Island. TVETA registers the institution as SHANZU TEACHERS TECHNICAL TRAINING COLLEGE under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0006/2020, first registered on 23 January 2020 with a licence valid to 5 September 2030, while the institution itself trades publicly as Shanzu Diploma Teachers' Training College and Shanzu Teachers Training College on its own website and portal. The college opened in May 1967 training P1, P2 and P3 teachers and today offers diploma and certificate programmes in primary and early childhood teacher education, business management, human resource management, ICT, project management, supply chain management and social work, examined by KNEC, KASNEB, NITA, ICM and IBM. A student portal is published at portal.shanzuttc.ac.ke and the college provides on-campus accommodation and library facilities.

description: The TVETA register consulted on 24 October 2026 records Sokoni Vocational Training Center under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0027/2022, registered on 31 October 2022 and licensed to 30 October 2027, with status 'Registered and Licensed', classified as a public vocational training centre in Kilifi County. A Kilifi County informal-settlements programme report published in April 2026 identifies Sokoni Vocational Training Centre as the institution that will host cabro-making training in Sokoni Ward, placing it in Kilifi town. It is registered and licensed by TVETA under TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0085/2016, registered on 14 April 2016 with a licence running to 26 July 2030. The college publishes the contact line +254 709 750 350 and the inbox info@hids.ac.ke.

about: Rarieda Training and Resource Centre (RTRC) is a community-driven private vocational training centre in Rarieda, Siaya County, Kenya, an initiative of the Rafiki wa Maendeleo Trust, registered by the TVET Authority under TVETA/PRIVATE/VTC/0015/2016 on 14 July 2016 with a licence running to 3 May 2028. description: Rarieda Training and Resource Centre is a private vocational training institution in Rarieda, Siaya County, regulated by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority. TVETA registered the centre as TVETA/PRIVATE/VTC/0015/2016 on 14 July 2016, and the register snapshot of 25 October 2026 records a Registered and Licensed status with an expiry date of 3 May 2028; the authority's october 2026 course table lists an ICDL Africa digital literacy certificate alongside NITA trade tests in carpentry and joinery, electrical wireman work, hairdressing, masonry, tailoring, dressmaking and beauty therapy (an archived November 2025 capture of the same register printed an 'Electrical Installation' name for the same NITA trade-test row; the 2026 snapshot's 'Electrical Wireman' is retained). The centre operates its own website at rtrc.ac.ke, which matches the record on name, community mission, Siaya/Rarieda location and TVETA registration, and publishes its postal address as P.O. The website extends the programme list with NITA trade-tested welding and fabrication, plumbing and pipe fitting, food and beverage, solar photovoltaic installation, fashion design and ICT, and KNEC-certificated Business Management and Social Work and Community Development programmes at certificate and diploma levels; these are sourced current offerings shown on the site, not regulator course rows. description: Amboseli Institute of Hospitality and Technology (AIHT) is a private hospitality and tourism tertiary institute accredited by the Kenyan Ministry of Education. Established in 1996, it has a legacy of over 25 years, committed to providing quality education and practical skills for the dynamic hospitality and tourism industries. The institute's main campus is located in Thika town, approximately 40 km from Nairobi. AIHT is known for its hands-on training, state-of-the-art equipment, and mandatory internships, aiming to equip students with the skills and knowledge necessary to excel in the competitive job market. The institute offers a range of certificate and diploma courses, with a focus on industry-centric curriculum and clear progression paths for students. They also offer distance learning options and plan to launch a fully online school in 2026.

description: Kenyatta University Kitui TVET Centre is the Kitui campus centre of Kenyatta University's Directorate of TVET Programmes and is registered and licensed by the TVET Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0018/2023, registered on 31 July 2023 with a licence valid to 30 July 2028. The Directorate's own website, tvet.ku.ac.ke - which a prior adjudication retained with a stored_wins decision as it is the payload's cited source for the centre's affiliation and programmes - states that its mandate includes coordinating the approval and licensing of certificate and diploma programmes by the TVET Authority, and that the Main, Kitui, Mombasa and Nakuru campuses are accredited as TVET centres delivering competency-based education and training curricula in TVETA-approved programmes. The TVET Authority register lists seven accredited programmes at Level 6 covering accountancy, business management, human resource management, information science, marketing, records management and information technology, and procurement and supply chain management; the register records the awarding university as the examination body and these are therefore recorded as internally examined. The payload now carries tvet.ku.ac.ke as basic_info.website with the Directorate's fetched pages as its source. The Directorate publishes its own contact channels in Nairobi (director-kutvet@ku.ac.ke, +254-20-8703854/55) but no separate telephone line, email address or postal address for the Kitui centre, so those fields remain null. No distance-learning or e-learning provision is published for the centre.

about: The Directorate of Technical and Vocational Education and Training at Kibabii University is the unit through which the university delivers TVET programmes in Bungoma County, Kenya, and it publishes diploma and certificate programmes spanning computing, business, applied sciences and information disciplines.
description: The Directorate of TVET at Kibabii University is presented on the university's own site as the unit that advances practical skills development, innovation and industry-aligned training, with a mandate covering competency-based curriculum development, infrastructure and resource enhancement, and entrepreneurship. The directorate publishes a programme page listing 22 diploma programmes and one certificate programme, covering computer programming, computer science, cyber security, data management and analysis, electronics, fingerprints and biometrics, ICT technician work, library and information science, network and system administration, applied biology, environmental management, aquaculture, business management, banking and finance, credit management, forex and securities, accountancy, cooperative management, human resource management, marketing, project management and supply chain management. The university's TVET programme pages state minimum entry requirements, with the Diploma in Fingerprints and Biometrics for example requiring a KCSE mean grade of C (minus) and running for three academic years. Kibabii University publishes its general enquiries line as +254 708 085 934 and its email as enquiries@kibu.ac.ke, with the postal address P.O. Box 1699-50200, Bungoma. The TVETA register separately records the directorate as a registered public TVC under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0035/2021.

description: The TVETA register consulted on 24 October 2026 records Jaribuni Vocational Training Center under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0039/2019, registered on 14 January 2019 and licensed to 27 February 2030, with status 'Registered and Licensed', classified as a public vocational training centre in Kilifi County. Five programmes are registered, covering motor vehicle mechanics, tailoring and dressmaking at NITA trade-test level plus information communication technology at KNEC craft level and secretarial studies at KNEC diploma level. The locality Jaribuni is taken from the institution's registered name because the regulator publishes no street address for the centre. No official website or verified official social page could be fetched, and a previously stored town value citing Kalimoni in Kajiado did not match the registered county and has been cleared.

about: Africa International University TVET Institute is the technical and vocational arm of Africa International University in Nairobi County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0127/2025. The register lists twenty-six TVET CDACC competency-based awards from level 3 to level 6 across hospitality, business, ICT, chaplaincy, ministry, counselling, social work and home-care fields.
description: Africa International University TVET Institute is recorded in the TVETA register of accredited TVET institutions as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0127/2025, registered on 29 July 2025 with a licence valid to 28 July 2030 under the status Registered and Licensed. The register places it in Nairobi County and classifies it as a private technical and vocational college, and its registered name identifies it as the TVET institute of Africa International University. Twenty-six accredited course rows are listed, all examined by TVET CDACC: eight at level 5, four at level 3, seven at level 4 and seven at level 6, covering hospitality and catering, business management, information communication technology, Christian ministry and chaplaincy, counselling psychology, social work, home care management, Kenyan Sign Language and office assistance. Register levels were normalised to the schema vocabulary, with CDACC levels 3 and 4 rendered as Artisan, level 5 as Certificate and level 6 as Diploma. The university publishes an ODeL directorate and online learning provision, so the learning modes are recorded as implied, but no TVET-institute-specific portal URL could be fetched in this pass and no verified student count, email address or named administrator was available.

It offers artisan, craft and diploma courses in building, automotive, electrical, cosmetology, fashion and food and beverage production, with a stated mission of producing competitive graduates through competency-based education and training.
description: Mathioya Technical and Vocational College was registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 12 January 2018 under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0015/2018, with a licence currently valid to 2 October 2028. The regulator lists the institution as a public Technical and Vocational College in Murang'a County. The college describes itself as committed to educating, preparing and inspiring trainees for Vision 2030, and offers both technical and business courses. Its published motto is 'Hands-on skill for self-reliance' and its vision is to be a world-class technical college for sustainable development. Departments advertised for the September 2026 intake include building, automotive, cosmetology, electrical, food and beverage production, and fashion and design, with admission requirements published as downloadable departmental lists. The TVETA register separately lists artisan, craft and diploma awards examined by KNEC together with NVCET and CDACC competency-based programmes.

description: Founded in 2005 by James and Irene Wagema, the Zabibu Disability Technical and Vocational Training Institute serves as a sanctuary for orphaned and vulnerable youth with physical and mental disabilities. Its mission is to move learners from dependency to independence by providing a safe, supportive environment for rehabilitation and practical skill development. The institute offers specialized vocational programs tailored to the needs of its students, fostering self-reliance and dignity through hands-on mastery of crafts and technical trades. Zabibu's unique value proposition is its holistic approach to disability empowerment, combining technical education with psycho-social support to ensure sustainable livelihoods for the marginalized.

description: The TVET Authority register lists this institution as IMANI MARIANISTS MARIA TRAINING CENTER under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0009/2015, registered on 17 February 2015 with a licence valid to 27 February 2030 as a private Technical and Vocational College in Nairobi County, and records thirteen course rows in food and beverage, catering and accommodation operations, catering management, hairdressing, beauty therapy, tailoring and dressmaking, examined by KNEC and NITA, with duplicate rows collapsed here. The operating organisation brands itself IMANI Marianists, an acronym for Initiative from the Marianists to Assist the Needy to be Independent, and describes itself as a faith-based vocational training organisation working in the Catholic Archdiocese of Nairobi that began in 1986 as a family centre supporting women. The Maria Training Center is one of its two Nairobi campuses, located behind St Teresa Catholic Church in Eastleigh and dated on the organisation's website to 1987, while the sister Chaminade Training Centre in Mukuru Kwa Njenga is separately registered by the TVET Authority. The organisation advertises seven six-month certificate programmes with a three-month industry attachment across its two campuses, including hairdressing and beauty, food production and service, clothing technology, ICT and AI tools, machine knitting, electrical and solar installation and metalwork, plus more than forty-five short courses with four intakes a year. No individual campus officer is named on its website, so no personal contact is recorded.

about: SCLP Samaj College, registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as SCLP SAMAJ AUSTRALIAN COLLEGE, is a not-for-profit technical and professional college in Nairobi operated under the Shree Cutch Leva Patel Samaj Charitable Trust. Founded in 2008 in partnership with the University of Western Sydney College in Australia, it now concentrates on technical, vocational and professional training.
description: SCLP Samaj College is a not-for-profit institution under the Shree Cutch Leva Patel Samaj Charitable Trust and a sister institution to SCLP Samaj School, founded in 2008 in partnership with the University of Western Sydney College in Australia and now focused on professional, technical and vocational training. The TVETA register carries the college under the registered name SCLP SAMAJ AUSTRALIAN COLLEGE, registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0133/2018, registered on 12 October 2018 with a licence valid to 22 July 2029 and a status of 'Registered and Licensed'; the institution currently trades and brands itself as SCLP Samaj College, and both names are recorded here because the regulator has not updated its register to the current trading name. Its programmes include ABE business diplomas at Levels 3 to 6, Pearson BTEC Level 3 Extended Diplomas in Engineering and in Information Technology, NITA craft courses at Grades 2 and 3 in automotive, mechanical and electrical engineering with optional dual BTEC certification, ACCA, and short IT and engineering skills courses. The college publishes its leadership as Chief Principal Mrs. Esther Sharma and Head of College and A-Level Mrs. Lizy Sabu, and describes facilities including 20 ICT-enabled classrooms with Wi-Fi and projectors, three engineering workshops, sports and recreation facilities, and a campus near Nairobi National Park. Its site states that it is fully accredited by TVETA and operates as a NITA trade testing centre, an ICDL testing centre and Pearson BTEC and ABE approved centre.

about: Egerton University is a public chartered university headquartered at its Njoro main campus on the Nakuru-Mau Narok Road in Nakuru County, with a Nakuru City Campus College and other campuses. Founded in 1939 as a farm school by Lord Maurice Egerton of Tatton and upgraded to an agricultural college in 1950, it became a university by Act of Parliament in 1987 and was re-chartered in 2013, and it now teaches through ten faculties.
description: Egerton University's own history page records that it was founded as a farm school in 1939 by Lord Maurice Egerton of Tatton, was upgraded to an agricultural college in 1950, was established as a university through the Egerton University Act of 1987 and was chartered afresh in 2013, and its profile page states that it now has ten faculties and two principal campuses, the Njoro main campus and the Nakuru Town Campus College. The fact sheet adds an E-Campus, Kenyatta Campus and Mpeketoni Campus, 19 diploma, 56 bachelor's, 67 master's and 50 doctorate programmes, and a 2024/2025 undergraduate enrolment of 5,668 students, which is the figure recorded as estimated_student_count. The CUE accredited programme register of 31 July 2026 lists Egerton's awards; twelve bachelor's degrees in agribusiness, arts, communication, economics, history, gender studies and peace education are enumerated in this record. The contacts page publishes the Njoro address on P.O. Box 536-20115 Egerton-Njoro, the general line +254-512110000, the admissions line +254772817106 and the address info@egerton.ac.ke, plus a separate Nakuru Town Campus College address on P.O. Box 13357-20100 Nakuru. The university's profile names a School of Open and Distance Learning at the Njoro campus, but no e-learning portal URL was confirmed live in this pass, so has_elearning is only implied and no official logo file or named officer with a published direct contact was found, leaving logo_url null and personal_contacts empty.

description: Topmax Training College is a private middle-level college in Nairobi County registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0034/2021, registered on 26 April 2021 with a licence valid to 30 April 2031 and a status of 'Registered and Licensed'. The regulator accredits thirteen programmes, all of which are recorded here: KNEC craft qualifications mapped to the schema level Certificate, KNEC diploma qualifications mapped to Diploma, and the KASNEB Certified Public Accountants qualification, which is a professional award recorded under the nearest schema level. The college also holds a second TVETA registration, TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0135/2024, for Topmax Training College Bee Centre, which operates as a separate registered unit. On its own website the college describes itself as offering artisan, certificate, diploma and advanced diploma programmes across schools of business and economics, ICT and engineering, hospitality and languages, beauty and fashion design, media studies, social sciences, health science and driving, and it publishes TVETA accreditation certificates for its health sciences programmes with graduates eligible for Kenya Health Professions Oversight Authority licensure. The site provides an online application route, a downloadable prospectus, a student portal, the telephone number +254 720 662991 and the inbox info@topmaxcollege.ac.ke. The regulator publishes only the county for this record, so no street address is asserted.

description: Eastlands College of Technology (ECT) began as the Informal Sector Business Institute (ISBI) in August 2003, initially training micro-entrepreneurs and youth in basic business skills and ICT. Officially opened in 2015, it is a project of the Strathmore Educational Trust, a Public Charitable Trust established in Kenya. The college aims to serve both the formal and informal sectors by providing skilled manpower with vocational, industrial, and entrepreneurial education. It employs a Dual Training System, linking students with corporations for industry-based training and job placement. ECT focuses on bridging industrial skill gaps, particularly in automotive, electrical, and mechanical engineering, and solar installation. It is registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0018/2016) as a private TVC and accredited by the National Industrial Training Authority (NITA).

about: St. Columba's Technical Training College is a private technical and vocational college at Mutune Village in Kitui County, Kenya, registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0139/2016 on 14 April 2016, with a licence valid to 26 July 2027. It was founded in 1970 by Columba McCourt of the Irish Ursuline Congregation and operates under the Catholic Diocese of Kitui, training in hairdressing and beauty, catering and food service, and fashion design and tailoring.
description: St. Columba's Technical Training College is a private TVET college registered by the TVET Authority under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0139/2016, registered on 14 April 2016 with a licence valid to 26 July 2027 and a register status of Registered and Licensed. Its own website describes it as a TVET college in Kitui County established by the Ursuline Sisters from Ireland, founded in 1970 by Columba McCourt of the Irish Ursuline Congregation, operating under the Catholic Diocese of Kitui and stating that it has provided technical training for over 2,000 young women. The site publishes its location as Mutune Village in Kitui County, email addresses info@stcolumbasttc.ac.ke and stcolumbasttc@gmail.com, and telephone numbers +254 720 081 973 and +254 725 567 355. Training is described in three areas: hairdressing and beauty, catering and food service, and fashion design and tailoring, alongside ICT. The TVET Authority register lists nine accredited KNEC programmes at artisan, craft and diploma level covering fashion design and garment making, food and beverage, information communication technology, clothing technology and hairdressing and beauty therapy. Kenyaplex corroborates the Kitui location, contact phone +254720081973, email info@stcolumbasttc.ac.ke, and website. No distance-learning or e-learning provision is published, so both learning-mode fields are recorded as none.

description: The Nyeri National Polytechnic is a public national polytechnic in Nyeri County, Central region, recorded by KUCCPS as a public college under the Ministry of Education and describing itself on its website as 'a national polytechnic of excellence' delivering quality training, skills development and applied research. Its published programme catalogue is organised by department - applied sciences, health sciences, engineering, ICT, business, hospitality and liberal studies - and lists each award with its national qualification level, duration and examining body, with NNP itself recorded as the examining body for every programme, which is why the courses below carry the exam body 'internal' rather than a national board. The catalogue shows a competency-based ladder from Level 3 artisan awards such as makeup artistry and Level 4 certificate awards such as dairy processing, through Level 5 diplomas and Level 6 higher diplomas in applied biology, applied statistics, analytical chemistry, food technology, dairy technology, community health and science laboratory technology, alongside fire rescue and pharmaceutical technology qualifications; the recorded course list reproduces the awards visible in the catalogue and omits short, non-levelled courses such as a two-week food safety course. The polytechnic runs a set of dedicated portals - an e-learning platform, a staff and student portal, an examinations portal, an e-library, an online application portal, an industrial placement portal and a graduation portal - and advertises a partnership network including the Northern Rangelands Trust recognition-of-prior-learning assessment visits. Its published contact points are info@thenyeripoly.ac.ke and 0724 477 942; no street address is printed on the pages checked, so the location is recorded only to town and county level, the enrolment figure is null because none is published, and the personal-contact list is empty because no named officer's individual contact appears.

description: The Sigalagala National Polytechnic is a publicly managed National Polytechnic in Ikolomani Constituency, Kakamega County, established in 1950 as the Nyanza Technical and Trade School on land and buildings inherited from British gold miners, converted into a Technical Training Institute in the late 1980s and elevated to National Polytechnic status by Legal Notice No. 90, The Sigalagala National Polytechnic Order, 2016. It operates three campuses - the Main Campus at Sigalagala, a Kakamega Town Campus and a Maturu Campus - and is mandated to offer programmes at artisan, craft, diploma and higher diploma levels across ten academic departments spanning building and civil engineering, electrical and electronics, mechanical and automotive engineering, computing and informatics, applied sciences, health sciences, hospitality and fashion, business and entrepreneurship, agriculture and environmental studies, and liberal studies. The TVETA register of accredited programmes records over sixty distinct qualifications for the polytechnic, including KNEC artisan, craft and diploma programmes and TVET CDACC competency-based levels 4 to 6, with the polytechnic's own website also advertising higher diploma progression in several engineering and applied science fields. TVETA records its registration as TVETA/PUBLIC/NP/0002/2017, first registered on 12 October 2017 and licensed to 25 January 2028, with a current status of Registered and Licensed.

description: Nyamira Institute of Science and Technology (NIST College) is a private tertiary institution registered with TVETA as a Technical and Vocational College under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0013/2015, having been registered on 2015-02-17 with a licence running to 2029-11-29. The institution states on its Facebook presence that it is located at Nyamira County headquarters on Nyamira-Senta Road, while the TVETA register records it in Kisii County. It offers Short Courses, Artisan, Certificate and Diploma courses in business, ICT, human resource management, supply chain management, nutrition and dietetics, information science and project management, all examined by KNEC. The TVETA register lists thirteen approved programmes with capped trainee intakes of 20 to 30 trainees per course. Its postal address is P.O. Box 558-40500 Nyamira, and its published contact email is info@nyamirainstitute.ac.ke.

description: Rift Koders Training Institute is registered by the TVETA as a private Technical and Vocational College under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0176/2024, registered on 29 October 2024 with a licence valid to 28 October 2029 in Nakuru County. The college trades as RiftKoders and describes itself as a coding school that blends creativity with learning for learners from about five years old through to adults, offering a progressive Kodarit curriculum affiliated to the Finnish education provider of that name, digital literacy, a full-stack development programme and a cyber security course. Its TVETA accredited programme list contains two qualifications, Cyber Security at CDACC Level 5 and Cyber Security at CDACC Level 6, both assessed by the TVET Curriculum Development, Assessment and Certification Council. Classes are advertised in physical, full-day laboratory and live online formats, and enrolment runs through an online admission portal on hub.riftkoders.com; because no learning-management-system URL is published, e-learning and distance delivery are recorded as implied rather than verified. The institute's own contact page currently displays only unused WordPress template placeholders (a Brooklyn, New York address, example.com email addresses and US phone numbers), which were treated as placeholder content and not recorded as institutional data; a third-party directory (Cybo) lists the institute as a computer-training business at the corner of Masaai Avenue and Digo Road, Nakuru. The institute's staff page lists Purvi Shah as Executive Director, but no direct contact route is published for her, so no personal contact is recorded.

about: Elburgon Vocational Training Centre is a public vocational training centre in Elburgon Ward, Molo Sub-County, Nakuru County, Kenya. It is registered and licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0006/2023 with a licence valid to 3 May 2028, and it appears on the County Government of Nakuru's list of county vocational training centres. The authority's register records NITA trade-test artisan programmes in electrical wireman, hairdressing, masonry, motor vehicle mechanics, plumbing and pipe fitting, tailoring, dressmaking and beauty therapy.
description: Elburgon Vocational Training Centre is a public Vocational Training Centre listed by the TVETA under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0006/2023, registered on 4 May 2023 with a licence expiring on 3 May 2028 and a register status of 'Registered and Licensed'. The County Government of Nakuru lists it among its vocational training centres, with its centre page placing the institution in Elburgon Ward of Molo Sub-County, Nakuru County, which is the location adopted here. Its accredited programme list consists entirely of artisan-level NITA trade-test courses: electrical wireman, hairdressing, masonry, motor vehicle mechanics, plumbing and pipe fitting, tailoring, dressmaking and beauty therapy; hairdressing and beauty therapy each appear as two identical rows in the register and have been collapsed into one entry. The institute's archived pages carry the institutional web domain, which is cited here, and the archived homepage prints the telephone line +254 796 044 225 recorded here; no email address is published on any fetched page. No enrolment figure, e-learning or distance-learning portal, facility inventory or named officer could be confirmed from a primary or regulatory source.

about: Kijabe College of Health Sciences (KCHS) is a private mission-driven medical college on the grounds of AIC Kijabe Hospital in Kijabe, Kiambu County, whose training lineage in Kijabe dates to 1915. It is a TVETA-licensed college (TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0057/2018) preparing nurses, clinical officers and allied-health professionals for Nursing Council, Clinical Officers Council and KMLTTB examinations, with diploma, higher-diploma, certificate and higher-national-diploma programmes (KRCHN, KRCCN, KRNA, KRPON, POTT, BMET, paediatric occupational therapy) and March and September intakes.
description: Medical training in Kijabe dates back to 1915 with a mission hospital, and the training school evolved into Kijabe College of Health Sciences, now a significant teaching and referral centre in East Africa; its mission is to provide top-level medical training grounded in Christian values and professional excellence, in close integration with AIC Kijabe Hospital, which provides students unparalleled clinical exposure across medical specialties. The college's own website (fetched on the live domain) advertises the Schools of Nursing, Clinical Medicine & Surgery and Allied Health: the School of Nursing offers a Diploma in Kenya Registered Community Health Nursing and Higher Diploma programmes in Kenya Registered Critical Care Nursing, Kenya Registered Nurse Anaesthesia and Perioperative Nursing (advertised as a Higher National Diploma); the School of Clinical Medicine & Surgery offers a Diploma in Kenya Registered Clinical Medicine and Surgery plus Higher Diploma programmes in Emergency and Critical Care, Family Health and Paediatric Emergency and Critical Care for Clinical Officers; the School of Allied Health offers a Certificate and Post-Basic Diploma in Peri-Operative Theatre Technology and a Higher Diploma in Paediatric Occupational Therapy. A Nursing Colleges registry (yca.co.ke) lists AIC Kijabe College of Health Sciences as an approved Kiambu nursing training institution with pre-service KRCHN and in-service KRCCN, KRNA and KRPON full-time programmes (that source identifies the county as Kiambu). The live site is now admitting students to a POTT-D Diploma in Perioperative Theatre Technology (September intake) and a BMET Diploma in Biomedical Engineering Technology (October 2026 intake), and 98% pass rate and 10+ programmes are claimed on the home page. Contact details fetched from the live kchs.ac.ke homepage and contact page are: phone +254 789 338 062 (tel/WhatsApp) with a second line +254 709 728 251, email kchs@kijabehospital.org, postal address P.O. Box 20-00220, Kijabe, Kenya; a stored line 0712504056 and stored address cad@kijabehospital.org could not be found on the live pages fetched this run and are retained as recorded on the database. The college site links a student portal at https://students.kchs.ac.ke/, a digital library at library.kchs.ac.ke and a 'KCHS Digital Campus' e-learning platform at http://elearning.kchs.ac.ke:8010 (college subdomain). The college is registered and licensed by TVETA as a private TVC under TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0057/2018 in Kiambu County (licence to 2029-03-02). No student population estimate, distance-learning programme or named officer with direct contact route could be verified, so no personal contact is recorded.

description: ELS Hospitality Training Center is a private hospitality training institution that began operating in September 2020 with the stated aim of bringing modern, practical hospitality education to Kenya. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority registers it as a Technical and Vocational College under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0185/2025, licensed to 28 July 2030 with status Registered and Licensed; the register's registration-date field for this record reads 1900-01-00, an evident data error in the regulator's system. The college publishes six international diploma programmes - culinary arts, culinary arts with pastry, hospitality management, accommodation and laundry service, food and beverage service, and front office operations - running one to two years with up to two industry internships, and an online variant of each diploma delivered over six months for experienced practitioners. Alongside the diplomas it advertises professional short courses of six to eight weeks in barista skills, mixology, cookery, pastry, waiting, housekeeping and laundry, events management, front office operations, hospitality supervision and hospitality management, and it offers recognition of prior learning assessment for experienced industry workers. Its homepage prints the address info@elshospitality.com, the lines 0707959038 and 0780288309, and its premises at 1st floor, Gitanga 48 building, Gitanga Road, Nairobi, so the e-mail is sourced to that page. Intakes run in January, May and September.

about: First American Health Institute (FAHI-Kenya) is a private health-training institution whose Nairobi campus is registered by TVETA as a Technical and Vocational College on Outering Road. It delivers certificate and diploma-level healthcare training, including caregiving, community health, healthcare support services and perioperative theatre technology, and also operates campuses in Voi and Mombasa.
description: First American Health Institute, trading as FAHI-Kenya, is a private health-training institution whose Nairobi campus is registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as a Technical and Vocational College under number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0216/2025, registered on 6 November 2025 and licensed to 5 November 2030 with status Registered and Licensed. The institute occupies House No. 6 on the first floor of the New Shell Service Station Building near Royal Victory Hospital on Outering Road, and it publishes additional offices in Voi (Taita Taveta County) and Mombasa (Mombasa County). The TVETA register lists four CDACC-examined programmes for the Nairobi campus: Caregiving at Level 4, and Community Health, Healthcare Support Services and Perioperative Theatre Technology, all at Level 5. On its own website the institute advertises a wider portfolio that it says includes a flagship Certified Nursing Assistant and Healthcare Support Assistant programme with a clinical hospital attachment, emergency medical technician training, phlebotomy, mortuary sciences, a Diploma in Nursing described as KNQF Level 6, IELTS and ASCPi examination preparation, and short courses in BLS, ACLS and first aid; those additional awards are published by the institute but are not yet reflected in the regulator's course table. The institute also offers hybrid, full-virtual and face-to-face learning modules and operates a home-based care agency and staffing service alongside its training arm. Its site states TVETA registration details as TVETA/PRIVATE/VTC/0014/2024, which does not match the registration number recorded for the Nairobi campus in the TVETA register, and the regulator's record is treated as authoritative here.

The course list recorded here is the regulator's table for that registration, deduplicated where the same course, level and examination body appeared twice, and it spans agriculture, building technology, electrical engineering, food and beverage, cosmetology, business, ICT, welding, solar photovoltaic installation and related trades. Levels are recorded as artisan for artisan and trade-test awards, certificate for craft awards and CDACC level four, diploma for KNEC diploma and CDACC level five, and higher diploma for CDACC level six. The regulator separately lists a Kiini Technical and Vocational College under its own registration, which is not attributed to this record. The campus telephone lines, e-mail addresses and postal box were not confirmed on any page fetched this run and are recorded as null or unknown.

about: The Kenya School of TVET (KSTVET), formerly the Kenya Technical Trainers College, is Kenya's national institution for training technical and vocational education trainers; it is a public National Polytechnic registered by the TVET Authority and operates a main campus in Gigiri, Nairobi, and a Moiben campus in Uasin Gishu County.
description: The TVET Authority register lists the institution as KENYA SCHOOL OF TVET under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/NP/0006/2016, registered on 14 July 2016 with a licence valid to 28 March 2030, categorised as a public National Polytechnic in Nairobi County, and records two accredited CDACC Level 5 programmes in criminal justice management and security management. The school's own website presents it as KSTVET, formerly KTTC, established in 1978 to train technically skilled personnel to teach in technical institutions, with a mandate to train technical teachers for all technical training institutions in the country and to conduct examinations and grant academic awards as provided under its establishing Order. Its main campus is on UN Avenue in Gigiri, opposite Gigiri Box Park and adjacent to the UNEP headquarters off Limuru Road, and its Moiben campus in Uasin Gishu County, opened in May 2025 and separately registered by the TVET Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0001/2026, houses the agriculture and applied sciences departments. Teaching spans nine academic departments including computer studies, business, education, electrical engineering, health and applied sciences, hospitality and institutional management, liberal studies and open and distance learning, offering a Diploma in Technical Training and a Certificate in Instructor Training for in-service and pre-service trainers, plus a large continuous professional development portfolio covering CBET curriculum development, competency-based assessment, digitalisation of content, dual TVET implementation, greening TVET, recognition of prior learning and leadership for TVET managers. The school runs a Moodle-based e-learning platform at elearning.kstvet.ac.ke, an admissions and student portal on the mycampuscurra platform, a CPD portal and a research repository, and it hosts the National ODeL in TVET centre. description: KMTC Makueni Campus is a campus of the Kenya Medical Training College, the state corporation established by an Act of Parliament under the Ministry of Health that runs 92 campuses across 46 counties with a student population the college reports as over 80,000. The college's February 2026 campus contacts directory gives the campus postal address P.O. Box 198-90300 Makueni, its institutional mailbox makueni@kmtc.ac.ke and its telephone line 0706037168, which match the values already held on this record. The college's September 2025 academic programmes booklet names Makueni as a centre for the upgrading Diploma in Nutrition and Dietetics, the upgrading Diploma in Orthopaedics and Trauma Medicine, the upgrading Diploma in Community Health and the upgrading Diploma in Health Records and Information, and lists it among campuses offering the one-year Health Care Assistant course; those campus-specific listings are the courses recorded here. KMTC teaches a unified curriculum across its campuses and operates the live Moodle portal at https://elearning.kmtc.ac.ke/, through which it delivers course content and examinations, and it publishes distance-learning higher diplomas including Palliative Care Nursing and Family Health Nursing. Campus-level student numbers, a street address, facilities and named campus officers are not published, so they remain null and the contacts list is empty.

description: Tharaka Technical Training Institute is a public institution established and registered under the TVET Act (Cap 17, Laws of Kenya), with its campus at Marimanti in Tharaka Nithi County. The institute was constructed between 2013 and 2017 by the Government of Kenya and is registered by TVETA under number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0015/2017, with the regulator's register showing a licence valid to 3 May 2028. It is one of the TVET institutions charged with training the middle-level technical and vocational labour force, and it states that its mandate is to fulfil the TVET vision of providing a competitive, market-driven TVET system delivering a competent workforce for sustainable development. Teaching is organised on the Competency-Based Education and Training model, with programmes in ICT, electronics and electrical installation, agriculture and business examined by KNEC and assessed by TVET CDACC at levels 4 to 6. The institute also runs a book centre and library and workshop-based practical training for its trainees.

description: S.A. description: Pan-African Shield College is a duly registered institution in Kenya, offering capacity building and education services for both individuals and organizations. Its courses are accredited by the Ministry of Education Training and Vocational Education Training Authority (TVETA), Private Security Regulatory Authority (PSRA), National Industrial Training Authority (NITA), and World Certification Institute (WCI). The American Society for Industrial Security (ASIS) International has also approved Pan-African Shield College Africa as an ASIS Preferred CPE Provider. The college prides itself on delivering exceptional training and capacity building services with impactful outcomes, providing individuals with opportunities to enhance their skills, knowledge, and competencies. Students obtain certifications in diverse areas offered by the college, which is headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, and works with strategic partners globally. The institution's vision is to be a leading capacity building institution, enhancing competencies among individuals and organizations globally. Its mission is to provide an environment where learners are empowered with relevant skills, knowledge, and competencies to be successful in ever-dynamic personal and business environments.

description: Bartek Institute - Kabarnet is a private technical and vocational college registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority on 18 July 2018 under registration number TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0112/2018, with a licence valid to 22 August 2029 in 'Registered and Licensed' status; the regulator records the category as TVC and the county as Baringo. The TVETA accredited course table lists ten qualifications: a KASNEB Certified Public Accountants professional course, KNEC craft programmes in information communication technology and secretarial studies, and KNEC diploma programmes in banking and finance, business management, co-operative management, human resource management, information communication technology, information studies and supply chain management. The register shows the same institute group operating a separate Eldama Ravine campus in Baringo under registration TVETA/PRIVATE/TVC/0009/2016. The KASNEB professional accountancy course is not recorded among the listed qualifications because the Schologic level vocabulary covers only artisan, certificate, diploma, higher diploma, degree, masters and doctorate awards. The regulator's record for this campus carries the telephone line printed here; no institutional website, postal address or email address was found published for this campus, so those details remain unconfirmed.

about: The Shamberere National Polytechnic (TSNP) is a public National Polytechnic at Kambi ya Mwanza, about one kilometre off the Kakamega-Malava-Webuye Road in Kakamega County, Western Kenya. Upgraded from Shamberere Technical Training Institute, it was registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as a National Polytechnic in 2024 and held its first graduation as a polytechnic on 8 August 2025.
description: The Shamberere National Polytechnic is a public National Polytechnic at Kambi ya Mwanza, roughly one kilometre off the Kakamega-Malava-Webuye Road in Kakamega County, Western Kenya, and is also referred to by its registered trading abbreviation TSNP. The institution was upgraded from Shamberere Technical Training Institute to National Polytechnic status, with the TVETA register recording it as TVETA/PUBLIC/NP/0010/2024, registered on 18 January 2024 and licensed to 17 January 2029 under a status of Registered and Licensed, and it celebrated its first graduation as a polytechnic on 8 August 2025. That register record and the regulator's programme table were taken from the archived capture of the TVETA institution-details page dated 11 May 2026, because the live tveta.go.ke domain is currently serving substituted third-party content. Its academic organisation covers departments of building and civil engineering, electrical and electronics engineering, mechanical and automotive engineering, computing and informatics, applied sciences, hospitality and institutional management, business and entrepreneurship studies, agriculture and environmental studies, and liberal studies, and the regulator's register of accredited programmes lists artisan, craft, diploma and higher diploma qualifications examined by KNEC, KASNEB and TVET CDACC; the register table publishes duplicate rows for titles offered more than once, so the rows here are de-duplicated by title and level and the award level is carried in each label where a title recurs. The polytechnic's own catalogue lists its competency-based programmes from Level 3 to Level 6 with the examination line 'Exam: TVET CDACC / T.S.N.P', which is consistent with CDACC assessment delivered at the polytechnic as assessment centre rather than a competing claim to the KNEC and KASNEB awards on the regulator's table. The polytechnic publishes income-generating activities including a guest house and conference service, catering services, a mechanical workshop producing metal products, a farm enterprise, an ICT production unit and a day care centre, and it provides student accommodation on a first-come, first-served basis. The institution publishes the telephone line +254 739 922 223 and the email info@shambererenationalpoly.ac.ke, and it operates a staff portal, a student self-service portal and institutional webmail alongside its public website.

about: Belgut Technical Training Institute (BETTI) is a public technical and vocational college in Kericho County registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0014/2019, first registered on 22 October 2019 with a licence valid to 13 December 2029. The college trades as Belgut TTI from Main, Litein Town and Sosiot campuses and advertises KNEC artisan, craft and diploma programmes alongside TVET CDACC level 4 to level 6 qualifications.
description: Belgut Technical Training Institute, which brands itself BETTI, is a public technical and vocational college in Kericho County. The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority registers it as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0014/2019, first registered on 22 October 2019 with a licence expiring on 13 December 2029, and the authority separately registers its Litein Campus as TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0011/2025. The institute's own website carries the current contact set - telephone +254 701 566 195, email belguttechnical@gmail.com and P.O. Box 205-20200, Kericho - and states that it runs Main, Litein Town and Sosiot campuses with intakes in January, May and September. Its TVETA course register holds 118 entries spanning artisan and craft qualifications examined by KNEC and TVET CDACC level 4, 5 and 6 qualifications in building and civil engineering, electrical and electronics, fashion and design, hospitality, business, agriculture, ICT and media. The institute's published prospectus lists the same level 3 to level 6 ladders by department, and it accepts applications through its CampusCura portal and participates in KUCCPS placement.

about: Kipkoyan Vocational Training Centre is a public vocational training centre registered by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority (TVETA) in Kericho County under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0010/2024, first registered on 15 May 2024 with a licence valid to 14 May 2029. The authority lists NITA trade test courses in computer operation, masonry, motor vehicle mechanics and plumbing and pipe fitting, and records the centre as a VTC under public ownership.
description: Kipkoyan Vocational Training Centre is a public vocational training centre in Kericho County licensed by the Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority as TVETA/PUBLIC/VTC/0010/2024. The authority registered it on 15 May 2024 with a licence running to 14 May 2029 and records the status as 'Registered and Licensed'. Its accredited course register contains four distinct NITA trade test qualifications once duplicate rows are collapsed: computer operator, masonry, motor vehicle mechanics, and plumbing and pipe fitting, all artisan-level trade qualifications. The centre is situated off Tegat Road in Kapsuser Ward, Belgut Sub-County, Kericho County, as documented in the County Government of Kericho Draft Annual Development Plan (ADP 2026-2027) which details road and infrastructure works connecting Kaplemeiywet Primary, Corner C, and Kipkoiyan Polytechnic off Tegat Road. This physical location in Kapsuser / Belgut is further independently corroborated by the National Government Constituencies Development Fund (NG-CDF) Belgut Constituency project records (BELGUT-1718.pdf) designating Kipkoyan Youth Polytechnic as an ICT hub site, the Kericho County Second Generation CIDP 2018-2022 citing Kipkoyan VTC as a center of excellence with a specialized plumbing workshop, and local directory listings placing the polytechnic at Kapsuser.

about: Brighter College is a private Technical and Vocational College operating in Ongata Rongai, Kajiado County, Kenya. The college states that it began operations in February 2013 and that its key competencies are in accountancy, information technology and technical fields. description: Brighter College describes itself on its own website as a Technical and Vocational Training institute that started operations in February 2013 and today presents itself as the leading TVET institute in Ongata Rongai, with key competencies in accountancy, IT and technical fields oriented to digital transformation. The regulator's accredited course table for this registration carries two programmes: Certified Public Accountants at Professional level examined by KASNEB, and Information Communication Technology at Craft level examined by KNEC; the professional KASNEB award has no equivalent in the canonical course-level vocabulary, so only the craft ICT programme is recorded as a structured course row and the CPA qualification is recorded here in narrative. The college's contact page gives its premises as the 3rd floor of the Ongata Rongai Women's Group Building, next to KCB Bank on Magadi Road, with telephone lines 0727 442315, 0782 191406 and 0722 832922 and the e-mail address brightercollege@gmail.com. No e-learning, distance-learning or virtual-campus provision is published on the pages fetched, and no teaching or teacher-training programme appears on the regulator's course table, so those attributes are recorded as absent or false rather than inferred. Course lists published by third-party directories for this college, including short computer-package and teacher-education titles, are not corroborated by the regulator's accredited table and are therefore not asserted in this record.

about: Tharaka University is a public chartered university at Marimanti in Tharaka Nithi County, Kenya, listed by the Commission for University Education as a Public Chartered University with a 2022 charter. It offers accredited bachelors, masters and doctoral programmes across education, agriculture, health sciences, computer science, mathematics, physics, chemistry, geology, mining technology, water and irrigation, renewable energy, criminology, business and Kiswahili, and runs both a learning management system and an open and distance learning portal.
description: Tharaka University holds a 2022 charter and is listed by the Commission for University Education as a Public Chartered University. The CUE accredited programme list records 38 register rows, which resolve to 37 distinct awards: 31 bachelors degrees, four masters programmes and two doctoral programmes. One register row names two awards together (Bachelor of Education (Arts) and Bachelor of Education (Science)); both are already recorded as separate rows, so the combined row was not duplicated. The academic portfolio covers education, agriculture, nursing, clinical medicine, public health, medical laboratory science, computer and information science, mathematics, physics, chemistry, geology, mining and mineral exploration, water and irrigation technology, renewable energy, criminology, business and Kiswahili. The university is based at Marimanti in Tharaka Nithi County and operates a learning management system at lms.tharaka.ac.ke and an open and distance learning portal at odel.tharaka.ac.ke, both of which answered live when checked on 2026-10-25.

description: Kituro Vocational Training Center is a public vocational training center situated in the Kabarnet Area of Baringo County, within Kenya's Rift Valley Region. The County Government has significantly invested in vocational training, including the construction of nine new Vocational Training Centers (VTCs) and the rehabilitation of thirteen existing institutions. This commitment extends to the acquisition of modern tools and equipment, with an investment exceeding Kshs 25 million. To enhance accessibility, bursaries are provided to all trainees in the county, covering 60% of the tuition fees. The center has seen a substantial increase in enrollment, from 526 trainees in 2013 to 1379 in 2023, with an ambitious goal to reach over 5,000 trainees by 2028. Furthermore, there are plans to establish at least one VTC as a center of excellence in a specific trade area within each sub-county, with Kituro Vocational Training Centre aiming to modernize its Carpentry Department to become a center of excellence.

description: Lang'ata TVC describes itself as a premier public TVET institution in Nairobi committed to quality, competency-based training in engineering, ICT, business and entrepreneurship, health sciences, hospitality, culinary arts and building technology. It operates under the Ministry of Education's State Department for TVET, with a motto of excellence in technology, innovation and entrepreneurship, and states that it works with industry and development partners while promoting green and digital skills in line with Kenya's Vision 2030. Applications are handled only through its portal at apply.langatatvc.ac.ke, and the college publishes CDACC assessment timetables and intake notices on its website. TVETA registers the college as a public Technical and Vocational College in Nairobi County under registration number TVETA/PUBLIC/TVC/0019/2022, registered on 2022-10-31 with licence expiry 2027-10-30, with accredited CDACC programmes from Level 3 to Level 6. Twenty-eight accredited course rows are recorded here, and because several programmes (plumbing, cosmetology, ICT, automotive engineering, building technology, business management, electrical engineering, office administration and health records and information technology) are accredited at more than one level, the level is carried in the label so that every award remains a separate row rather than being collapsed into a single name.

description: Austra Training Institute operates from Komora Centre on the fourth floor of Room 415 in Eldoret, Uasin Gishu County, and describes itself as a TVET-accredited vocational training provider preparing learners for domestic and international careers. Its website organises provision into six schools: Languages and International Studies, Science Engineering and Technology, Business Management and Economics, Health and Social Sciences, Hospitality and Tourism, and Music and Media Arts, advertising more than fifty courses. Featured programmes include the Certificate in Nurse Assistant, a dual qualification in Certificate III in Individual Support covering ageing and disability, and AutoCAD for Civil Engineering, and the institute also teaches German from A1 to B2 alongside IELTS preparation and caregiving pathways to Germany. The site lists TVETA, CDACC, KNEC, NITA and the Ministry of Education among its partners, but it does not publish a TVETA registration number and no matching entry could be located in the TVETA public register under this name, so the accreditation recorded here is the institute's own stated TVET accreditation rather than a verified registration.
